limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

limitations: 完整固定inventory；定向核根manifest/独立启动/插件树与DSH配置、console/authn/共享REST、workforce调用/身份/permit/策略/薄工具/存储、MCP adapter→网关→真实HTTP及结果、UHP创建/消息/单步执行/取消。未全审所有子包、UI、OAuth/凭据轮换、全部组织/风险/旁路/存储迁移和协议分支；未运行目标、作者测试、真实账户/模型/业务动作。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 面向有平台团队的多部门AI资源治理；单位成果是已授权主体完成一项真实调用并能核对结果、用量与审计，不是资产条目或演示通过。根组件是基础设施平台，见[Q01](#research-q01)。
代表入口把认证主体、能力清单/permit、步骤预留、事务外MCP传输和领域状态串联；内置UHP另走单次真实模型调用，完整Agent工具循环依赖宿主或外部harness。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。

完整固定inventory；定向核根manifest/独立启动/插件树与DSH配置、console/authn/共享REST、workforce调用/身份/permit/策略/薄工具/存储、MCP adapter→网关→真实HTTP及结果、UHP创建/消息/单步执行/取消。未全审所有子包、UI、OAuth/凭据轮换、全部组织/风险/旁路/存储迁移和协议分支；未运行目标、作者测试、真实账户/模型/业务动作。
private根dsh-enterprise-ops1.5.0、MIT、Node>=22.6，源码start带类型剥离；DSH兼容声明>=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0且web。独立/DSH两种装配不等当前宿主或部署已验收。
总负担集中在权限运营、凭据、备份和外部结果对账；内部计量归因不等实际供应商账单，单步取消也不保证停止计费。四阶段明细见[Q05](#research-q05)。
观察，先有真实匿名案件与平台/恢复责任人，再做一个资源的小样；无账实一致、结果恢复及净维护收益就不扩域，详见[Q06](#research-q06)。
当前可确认的是治理调用链的可检查性；结果返回、持久回放和任务真正完成需要不同证据。效果表见[Q05](#research-q05)，反例及当前缺口见[Q04](#research-q04)。
短事务预留与网络分离、领域状态和失败停写语义可借鉴；复用时要同时绑定资源目标和结果收据，并验动态权限/协议变体。启动探针和flush不能替代外部任务关账，见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q04](#research-q04)。
共享治理对象真正接到受控调用：调用方身份进入permit/manifest检查，预留后才经实际MCP传输，结果再回领域状态。增量是这些边界的组合，不是声明所有域已闭环或内置通用自治Agent。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
本地completed和去重不等完整业务恢复：同键只核参数，首次value/content没有随账本完整持久回放，网关强收据也有降级；SSE/错误/动态撤权需按实际接口验收，不能凭状态和方法名补齐。见[Q04](#research-q04)。
在现有permit/账本上把资源目标与可恢复结果收据绑定，再交已有宿主Agent继续决策；先用一种资源的真实匿名案件比较错结果、重复动作和管理员负担，无优势就不扩域。该增量未实现/未验证，详见[Q06](#research-q06)。
身份/任用/permit与真实资源凭据是执行前提；自主任务另需消费工具结果的宿主或harness，不能由平台安装补齐。独立实例、存储和恢复责任表见[Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)成熟IAM/数据库/协议组合有独立接线，novelty9超过无增量0、不达新机制18；[Q02](#research-q02)主体/permit/预留/事务外调用是真机制，mechanism15超过接口目录8，但[Q04](#research-q04)结果/目标与动态边界未完整封闭不23。该调用协议可迁移但依赖组织/资源/回执语义，transferability10超过仅本项目5，不到成熟跨场景15；共享接口减少材料分散但多域运营/恢复更重，simplification4不进明显简化8，也非完全无组织增量0。

business.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)统一主体与调用账本改变治理部分流程，workflow18超过单点9，内置执行非完整自治任务且缺生产案例不26。真实业务结果/领域状态交付15超过单报告8，[Q04](#research-q04)回放/外部回执未闭环不23；控制台/DSH两入口有接入便利reach5，仍需平台团队不进新人群10。内部按主体组织调用归因具成本管理增量economics4，超过纯展示0，但强收据/实际账单与净收益未验不8；不把封存billing当商业结算。

recommendation.reason: 有多部门AI资源治理需求且具备平台团队、权限运营和恢复责任人的组织，可先收集一种资源的真实匿名任务作为评估输入。源码把身份、permit、真实MCP调用和账本串联，但内置UHP仅单步模型执行，当前没有完整结果恢复与全域生产验收。如果无法对上外部真实动作、重复请求的结果或审计用量，应停止扩域和自动写入，核对在途后退回现有网关与人工对账。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)多主体/多资源治理有具体授权交付任务，超过泛便利15；没有真实组织案件和关键收益验证，23不30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)共用permit/步骤账本与真实执行优于只有台账声明6；[Q03](#research-q03)循环依外部、[Q04](#research-q04)结果恢复与治理负担仍关键，13不进明显已支持优势19。

evidence.rationale: 追到认证/权限/permit/参数/预留/适配器/HTTP/业务返回/持久与回放，另核UHP实际caller和单步模型，正反证超过零散材料6；仅代表链源核、无运行/全域验证，13为源码上限不19。

cost.rationale: [Q05](#research-q05)可隔离单资源、备份和停止派发，优于无退出0；多种存储/密钥/动态权限/外部unknown恢复与管理员工时高且未测，5不进可管理负担10。

publication.summaries.text: 企业AI资源治理平台，管理身份、MCP/Agent等资产，提供受控调用、模型接入、计量审计与控制台。

items.模型工具: workforce_claim/invoke/renew/submit接真实域服务，透传领域状态和首调用结果。
items.Host 路由: 独立平台REST及DSH装配桥接路径；已追代表受控调用入口。
items.后台: UHP异步单步真实模型执行、续接记录与进度事件；无内置工具循环。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 身份/资源治理 | 组织主体、能力清单、permit和受控API | 本轮核代表链，不推广全域安全验收 |
| 受控MCP调用 | 参数/风险/权限后真实HTTP执行并落账 | 明确real/demo，结果回放与强回执另验 |
| UHP模型执行 | 单轮模型、会话续接及取消交付控制 | 非通用工具循环；自主任务借宿主/外部harness |
| 运行与恢复 | 启动探针、步骤账本与存储 | 单进程和多存储/外部核验负担，退出码非办结证明 |

publication.advice.text: 观察，先有真实匿名案件与平台/恢复责任人，再做一个资源的小样；无账实一致、结果恢复及净维护收益就不扩域，详见[Q06](#research-q06)。

[`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)。\n\n```\n基础层   platform-core      存储 · 事件总线 · HTTP · ToolRuntime-lite · YAML · 签名 · 场景图谱\n底座     resource-core      资源本体:schema + 生命周期状态机 + 依赖图\n业务域   iam · authn · usage · audit · market · connector · mcp · nas · skillhub\n         agent · app · modelgw · connect · update · portal · flow-core · exec-hub · workforce\n接入层   console · panel-core · /path/to/ybkkasi/packages/plugin-rq-card\n> ```\n>\n> 另:浏览器半 bundle(`packages/plugin-rq-card/lib/client.js`)已随仓库入库,无需现场构建;\n> 若源码改动过 rq-card 前端,重跑 `node packages/plugin-rq-card/build.mjs`。\n\n> ⚠️ 宿主形态依赖 dsh `>=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0`。dsh 目前仍是 developer preview,\n> 官方明示会有破坏性变更。**独立宿主形态不依赖 dsh 版本稳定性**,是最稳的部署方式。\n> 详见 [`docs/host-features-ops-notes.md`](docs/host-features-ops-notes.md)。\n\n---\n\n## 接口面\n\n**CLI**(`dshctl.mjs`,16 组命令,机器可读优先):\n\n```\norg / user / role / group      组织与账号\ntoken / credential             令牌与机器凭证\nplugin / skill / mcp           资产:市场 / Skill / MCP 服务\nconnector / nas                SaaS 连接器 / NAS 存储\nusage / connect / update       计量 / 远程 dsh 接入 / 平台自更新\nsync / conflict / help         三方同步 / 组织冲突 / 帮助\n```\n\n**REST**——463 条去重路由(代码注册口径,运行时实测;完整接口清单可经 `GET /api/openapi.json` 机器可读获取,登录令牌访问),全部经统一鉴权中间件 + RBAC;\n未匹配路由的匿名请求统一返回 401(而非 404),不提供路由探测侧信道。\n\n**MCP**——平台即 MCP Server,任意 MCP 客户端可直接接入;86 个注册工具\n**均已声明最小权限 permission**。\n\n**协议契约**——对外协议键保持 ASCII 不改写,中文释义见\n[`docs/协议键中文对照总表.md`](docs/协议键中文对照总表.md);\n能力契约见 `docs/contract-{c1,c2,c3,j1,j2,j3,j4}-*.md`。\n\n---\n\n## 诚实边界\n\n这个项目的价值有一半在于它**明确说清了自己不做什么**:\n\n- **免登演示态**(`DEMO_MODE=1`):**不新增鉴权面、不发令牌、不开写权限**——仅在既有\n  console 鉴权中间件的「无 Bearer 头」分支注入固定只读主体(26 个 `.read` 点白名单,\n  无 `*`);写方法入口直接 405,带 Bearer 的真实登录路径行为完全不变。代价说清楚:\n  它开放实例**全部只读数据视图**给任何能访问端口的人,仅限演示种子数据实例,默认关闭。\n- **存储**:业务集合**双形态**——默认 JSON 集合(原子落盘);`PLATFORM_STORAGE=sqlite` 切换\n  SQLite 后端(WAL + `synchronous=FULL` + 事务,首启自动回填既有 JSON 数据,`uniqueOn`\n  落为引擎级 UNIQUE INDEX,JSON 文件保留为回滚源)。计量与事务数据始终为 SQLite\n  (`data/txnstore.db`)。**两种形态都是单进程、无水平扩展**——多节点 HA 需要 Postgres\n  后端,规划见 [`docs/adr-0001-storage-migration.md`](docs/adr-0001-storage-migration.md)。\n- **MCP 执行层**:支持真实 HTTP 传输(`exec: real`);`exec: demo` 是**显式标注**的降级演示层\n  (确定性模拟、不计入计量与 SLO)。\n- **模型网关**:仅转发 OpenAI 兼容 `chat/completions`;未配置 endpoint 时**直接报错,\n  绝不生成假 completion 充数**。\n- **NAS 文件操作**:全部经 MCP 文件网关,不直连 DSM 私有 API;\n  `fs_upload/fs_download` 在网关进程侧读写本地路径,平台与网关需同机部署或配共享挂载。\n- **OIDC 私钥**存 data 目录,生产建议迁 KMS。\n- **i18n**:运行时支持 zh-CN(默认)/ en-US / ja-JP 实时切换,未命中优雅降级中文;\n  协议层 ASCII 键在任何语言版本中不改写。架构已支持 i18n,出海市场按需推进。\n- **计费**:平台不转售、不分账。对外只呈现**用量与内部成本穿透**(价格簿为零价快照,\n  `charge` 恒 0),原钱包/分账子系统已下线封存。\n\n---\n\n## 与市面方案的关系\n\n| 层                | 代表方案                                  | 元冰可的位置                                  |\n| ---------------- | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |\n| AI / LLM Gateway | LiteLLM · Portkey · Higress · Bifrost | 不竞争。网关解决**流量路由与成本可见**,这里解决**资产治理与责任归属** |\n| LLMOps 可观测       | Langfuse · LangSmith · Braintrust     | 不竞争,但**互补**——这里有计量与审计,缺 trace/eval 深度   |\n| Agent 构建平台       | Dify · Coze · FastGPT                 | 不同赛道。这里不构建 Agent,只**治理**已建成的            |\n| **AI 资产治理**      | 无成熟方案（早期玩家:Monospace / Busabase / AgentValet）| ✅ **这一层** |\n| 企业 MaaS 私有化      | 阿里百炼 · 百度 · 蚂蚁 Agentar                | 轻量,可完全私有化,不绑云合同                         |\n\n这是一个**刚被验证需求的新品类**——网关上在做流量、可观测在做 trace、构建平台在做 Agent,\n但「企业里已经建成的那些 AI 资产归谁管」这一层还没有成熟答案。\n\n大多数团队现在的状态是:MCP 服务散在各处没人知道谁在用、Agent 拿着万能 token 横冲直撞、\n模型账单月底出来没人说得清哪个部门花的、出了问题查不到审计记录。\n元冰可把这些**统一成\"资产\"**,每类资产共享同一套底座。\n\n---\n\n## 开发\n\n```bash\nnpm run selftest              # 1621 项端到端断言(含 P95 尾延迟闸门 + 故障注入 + SQLite 后端契约)\nnpm run lint:manifests        # 插件清单校验\nnpm run lint:boot-order       # 插件装配顺序\nnpm run lint:cjk              # 中文残留门禁\nnpm run manifests             # 重新生成清单\n\nnode scripts/storage-bench.mjs         #       "content": "/**\n * 事务型存储：计量与资金类数据的专用底座（生态设计 v1.2 第 0 步，S1 消解）。\n *\n * 与 JSON 集合存储（storage.ts）的分工：\n *   - storage  ：业务配置/资源数据（防抖落盘足够）\n *   - txnStore ：计量流水 / 资金流水 / 分账分录 —— 只追加、需事务、需引擎级幂等\n *\n * 基于 node:sqlite（Node ≥ 22.5 内置，零依赖）。WAL 模式。\n * 资金类表只允许 INSERT（服务层不暴露 UPDATE/DELETE 于 journal 类表）。\n */\nimport { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'\nimport { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { join } from 'node:path'\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { Service } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\n\nexport interface TxnStoreConfig {\n  /** 数据目录（与 storage 同目录），默认 `<cwd>/data`。 */\n  dataDir?: string\n}\n\nexport type SqlValue = string | number | null\n\nexport class SqliteTxnService extends Service {\n  static readonly provide = 'txnStore'\n\n  readonly db: DatabaseSync\n  readonly file: string\n\n  constructor(ctx: Context, config: TxnStoreConfig = {}) {\n    super(ctx, 'txnStore')\n    const dataDir = config.dataDir ?? join(process.cwd(), 'data')\n    this.file = join(dataDir, 'txnstore.db')\n    mkdirSync(dataDir, { recursive: true })\n    this.db = new DatabaseSync(this.file)\n    this.db.exec('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL')\n    this.db.exec('PRAGMA synchronous = FULL')\n    this.db.exec('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON')\n    ctx.effect(() => () => {\n      try {\n        this.db.close()\n      } catch {\n        /* 已关闭 */\n      }\n    })\n  }\n\n  /** 建表（幂等）。columns 为「列名 → 列定义（含类型与约束）」。 */\n  ensureTable(name: string, columns: Record<string, string>, options: { primaryKey?: string[]; uniques?: string[][]; indexes?: string[][] } = {}): void {\n    const pk = options.primaryKey ?? ['id']\n    const cols = Object.entries(columns).map(([key, def]) => `${quoteIdent(key)} ${def}`)\n    cols.push(`PRIMARY KEY (${pk.map(quoteIdent).join(', ')})`)\n    this.db.exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${quoteIdent(name)} (${cols.join(', ')})`)\n    for (const unique of options.uniques ?? []) {\n      this.db.exec(`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ${quoteIdent(`ux_${name}_${unique.join('_')}`)} ON ${quoteIdent(name)} (${unique.map(quoteIdent).join(', ')})`)\n    }\n    for (const index of options.indexes ?? []) {\n      this.db.exec(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ${quoteIdent(`ix_${name}_${index.join('_')}`)} ON ${quoteIdent(name)} (${index.map(quoteIdent).join(', ')})`)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** 插入（主键/唯一索引冲突时静默忽略）。返回是否真正插入。 */\n  insertOrIgnore(table: string, row: Record<string, SqlValue>): boolean {\n    const keys = Object.keys(row)\n    const result = this.db\n      .prepare(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO ${quoteIdent(table)} (${keys.map(quoteIdent).join(', ')}) VALUES (${keys.map(() => '?').join(', ')})`)\n      .run(...keys.map((key) => row[key] ?? null))\n    return Number(result.changes) > 0\n  }\n\n  /** 插入（冲突抛错）。 */\n  insert(table: string, row: Record<string, SqlValue>): void {\n    const keys = Object.keys(row)\n    this.db\n      .prepare(`INSERT INTO ${quoteIdent(table)} (${keys.map(quoteIdent).join(', ')}) VALUES (${keys.map(() => '?').join(', ')})`)\n      .run(...keys.map((key) => row[key] ?? null))\n  }\n\n  /** 按主键更新（仅允许非只追加表使用；journal 类表禁止调用）。 */\n  updateByKey(table: string, primaryKey: string[], keyValues: SqlValue[], patch: Record<string, SqlValue>): void {\n    const setSql = Object.keys(patch).map((key) => `${quoteIdent(key)} = ?`).join(', ')\n    const whereSql = primaryKey.map((key) => `${quoteIdent(key)} = ?`).join(' AND ')\n    this.db\n      .prepare(`UPDATE ${quoteIdent(table)} SET ${setSql} WHERE ${whereSql}`)\n      .run(...Object.values(patch), ...keyValues)\n  }\n\n  /** 全表（或按等值条件）查询。 */\n  all<T = Record<string, SqlValue>>(table: string, where: Record<string, SqlValue> = {}): T[] {\n    const keys = Object.keys(where)\n    if (keys.length === 0) return this.db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM ${quoteIdent(table)}`).all() as T[]\n    const whereSql = keys.map((key) => `${quoteIdent(key)} = ?`).join(' AND ')\n    return this.db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM ${quoteIdent(table)} WHERE ${whereSql}`).all(...keys.map((key) => where[key] ?? null)) as T[]\n  }\n\n  one<T = Record<string, SqlValue>>(table: string, where: Record<string, SqlValue>): T | undefined {\n    const rows = this.all<T>(table, where)\n    return rows[0]\n  }\n\n  count(table: string, where: Record<string, SqlValue> = {}): number {\n    const keys = Object.keys(where)\n    if (keys.length === 0) {\n      return Number((this.db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ${quoteIdent(table)}`).get() as { n: number }).n)\n    }\n    const whereSql = keys.map((key) => `${quoteIdent(key)} = ?`).join(' AND ')\n    const row = this.db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ${quoteIdent(table)} WHERE ${whereSql}`).get(...keys.map((key) => where[key] ?? null)) as { n: number }\n    return Number(row.n)\n  }\n\n  /** 原生 SQL（建索引/聚合查询等）。 */\n  sql<T = Record<string, SqlValue>>(query: string, params: SqlValue[] = []): T[] {\n    return this.db.prepare(query).all(...params) as T[]\n  }\n\n  /** 原生写语句（UPDATE/DELETE），返回受影响行数。 */\n  run(query: string, params: SqlValue[] = []): number {\n    return Number(this.db.prepare(query).run(...params).changes)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 事务：fn 内的全部写入要么全部提交、要么全部回滚。\n   * 同步执行（node:sqlite），BEGIN IMMEDIATE 立即取写锁，避免升级死锁。\n   */\n  txn<T>(fn: () => T): T {\n    this.db.exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')\n    try {\n      const result = fn()\n      this.db.exec('COMMIT')\n      return result\n    } catch (error) {\n      try {\n        this.db.exec('ROLLBACK')\n      } catch {\n        /* 连接异常时回滚失败仅记录 */\n      }\n      throw error\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nfunction quoteIdent(name: string): string {\n  if (!/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(name)) throw new Error(`非法标识符：${name}`)\n  return `\"${name}\"`\n}\n"

'login',\n      ...(record.userId !== undefined ? { userId: record.userId } : {}),\n      ...(record.configId !== undefined ? { configId: record.configId } : {}),\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 完成扫码绑定（purpose=bind）：state 一次性消费 → Adapter 链换 unionId\n   * → 绑定到 state 锁定的平台账号。全程无需手工输入任何三方 ID。\n   * 「一人一号」由 identityLinks 引擎级唯一约束兜底。\n   */\n  async completeSsoBind(code: string, state: string): Promise<{ userId: string; provider: string; displayName: string; providerUserId: string }> {\n    const stateRecord = this.oauthStates().get(state)\n    if (!stateRecord) throw new Error(t('state 无效（未发起授权或已消费）'))\n    if (stateRecord.consumedAt) throw new Error(t('state 已被使用（防重放）'))\n    if ((stateRecord.purpose ?? }\n  }\n\n  private loadRetiredSecrets(): void {\n    try {\n      const file = join(this.ctx.opsStorage.dataDirPath, 'authn-signing-secret-history.json')\n      if (!existsSync(file)) return\n console.error('[authn] 退役密钥历史落盘失败（仅影响轮换宽限）', error)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 轮换签名密钥（评审 S2 修复）：旧密钥进入宽限期（默认 24h）而非立即作废——\n   * 宽限期内旧令牌仍可通过验签（在途请求不掉线），宽限期后自然失效；\n   * 会话可随时用 refresh token 'real',\n      ...(input.bridgeFrom ? { bridgeFrom: input.bridgeFrom } : {}),\n    })\n  }\n\n  /** 通用 PATCH 允许直改的字段（治理归属 ownerEntity 不在列——走专用归属指派端点做资源校验）。 */\n  private static readonly UPDATABLE_KEYS = [\n    'name', 'description', 'icon', 'endpoint', 'tools', 'headers', 'rateLimitPerMin', 'category',\n  ] as const\n\n  updateService(id: string, patch: Partial<Pick<McpServiceRecord,\n    'name' | 'description' | 'icon' | 'endpoint' | 'tools' | 'headers' | 'rateLimitPerMin' | 'category'\n    | 'capabilityId' | 'exposureMode' | 'dataClass' | 'environment' | 'visibility' | 'credentialRef'\n  >>): McpServiceRecord {\n    const service = this.requireService(id)\n    if (service.status === 'online' && patch.tools) {\n      throw new Error(t('在线服务修改 Tool Schema 需先灰度新版本（版本不可变原则）'))\n    }\n    // 治理字段枚举校验（契约 §5）；白名单收敛写入键——REST PATCH 透传 body 的历史行为下\n    // 未知键会被盲写进记录，治理字段必须经校验路径（ownerEntity 走专用端点，防绕过资源校验）\n    const governance = normalizeGovernanceInput(patch)\n    const next: Record<string, unknown> = {}\n    for (const key of McpService.UPDATABLE_KEYS) {\n      if (patch[key] !== undefined) next[key] = patch[key]\n    }\n    if (next['category'] !== undefined) next['category'] = normalizeAssetCategory(next['category'])\n    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(governance)) next[key] = value\n    if (patch.capabilityId !== undefined) next.capabilityId = patch.capabilityId\n    if (patch.credentialRef !== undefined) next.credentialRef = patch.credentialRef\n    return this.services().update(id, next as Partial<McpServiceRecord>)\n  }\n\n  // -- 治理：归属指派 / 治理待办 / 存量迁移（W1-T2，契约 §5） --------------------------------\n\n  /**\n   * 归属指派：仅做形态校验与落库；type=app/agent 的资源存在性校验在 REST 层经\n   * resourceCore 完成（plugin-mcp 不依赖 resource-core，保持装配面最小）。\n   */\n  setOwnerEntity(id: string, ownerEntity: McpOwnerEntity): McpServiceRecord {\n    const normalized = normalizeGovernanceInput({ ownerEntity })\n    return this.services().update(id, { ownerEntity: normalized.ownerEntity! })\n  }\n\n  /** 治理待办摘要（只读，契约 §5）：unowned / 明文敏感头 / 非 gateway 暴露 三类 + 总量。 */\n  governanceSummary(): {\n    unowned: Array<{ serviceId: string; serviceName: string; reason: string }>\n    plainHeaderServices: Array<{ serviceId: string; serviceName: string; keys: string[] }>\n    nonGateway: Array<{ serviceId: string; serviceName: string; exposureMode: string }>\n    totals: { services: number; unowned: number; plainHeader: number; nonGateway: number }\n  } {\n    const services = this.services().all()\n    const unowned = services\n      .filter((service) => !service.ownerEntity || service.ownerEntity.type === 'platform' || !service.ownerEntity.id)\n      .map((service) => ({\n        serviceId: service.id,\n        serviceName: service.name,\n        reason: !service.ownerEntity || service.ownerEntity.type === 'platform'\n          ? t('归属未指派（platform 占位，待能力绑定/指派）')\n          : t('ownerEntity.type={type} 缺少资源 id', { type: service.ownerEntity.type }),\n      }))\n    const plainHeaderServices = services\n      .map((service) => ({ service, keys: sensitiveHeaderKeys(service.headers) }))\n      .filter((item) => item.keys.length > 0)\n      .map(({ service, keys }) => ({ serviceId: service.id, serviceName: service.name, keys }))\n    const nonGateway = services\n      .filter((service) => (service.exposureMode ?? { credentialRef: description.credentialRef } : {}),\n      })\n    }\n    return { dryRun: false, candidates, migrated: candidates.length }\n  }\n\n  /** 连接远端 MCP 服务拉取工具清单（initialize → tools/list）；导入与同步共用。 */\n  async listRemoteTools(endpoint: string, headers?: Record<string, string>): Promise<McpToolSpec[]> {\n    const sessionId = await this.ensureSession(endpoint, headers)\n    const { payload } = await this.mcpRequest(endpoint, headers, {\n      jsonrpc: '2.0',\n      id: `dsh-list-${Date.now()}`,\n      method: 'tools/list',\n      params: {},\n    }, REAL_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS, sessionId)\n    if (payload?.error) throw new Error(t('tools/list 失败：{reason}', { reason: payload.error.message ?? ''),\n        inputSchema: tool.inputSchema && typeof tool.inputSchema === 'object' && !Array.isArray(tool.inputSchema)\n          ? tool.inputSchema as Record<string, unknown>\n          : { type: 'object', properties: {} },\n        // V11 根治核心：远端 tools/list 不再隐式映射 read——远端清单无法自证风险，\n        // 一律 'unknown' 入账，写能力须经风险登记（mcpToolRisks）审批生效后放行。\n        riskLevel: 'unknown' as const,\n      }))\n      .filter((tool: McpToolSpec) => tool.name)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 外部服务工具同步：以远端 tools/list 为准刷新本地清单。\n   * 绕过 updateService 的版本不可变校验——外部服务的工具清单是远端事实的镜像同步，\n   * 不是平台侧的版本变更（版本流程仍约束托管服务）。\n   */\n  async syncTools(serviceId: string): Promise<McpServiceRecord> {\n    const service = this.requireService(serviceId)\n    if (service.mode !== 'external') throw new Error(t('仅外部注册服务支持工具同步'))\n    if (service.exec !== 'real') throw new Error(t('演示传输层服务不支持工具同步'))\n    // W1-T2 §6 注入点：透传前经 SecretBroker 组装凭证头（存量非敏感 headers 照旧）\n    const tools = await this.listRemoteTools(service.endpoint, await this.resolveCallHeaders(service))\n    if (!tools.length) throw new Error(t('远端服务未返回任何工具'))\n    const updated = this.services().update(serviceId, { tools })\n    this.noteBusinessSuccess(updated)\n    return updated\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * mcpServers JSON 一键导入（Claude Desktop / Cursor / Cherry Studio 等工具通行的配置形态）：\n   * 解析 → 注册外部服务（exec=real）→ initialize+tools/list 自动发现工具 →（可选）验证并上线。\n   * 单条目失败不阻断其余条目；远端不可达时保留草稿并回传原因。\n   */\n  async importServices(input: { config: string | object; orgId: string; owner: string; autoDeploy?: boolean }): Promise<{\n    imported: number\n    results: McpImportResult[]\n  }> {\n    const entries = parseMcpServersConfig(input.config)\n    const results: McpImportResult[] = []\n    for (const entry of entries) {\n      if (entry.error) {\n        results.push({ name: entry.name, ok: false, error: entry.error })\n        continue\n      }\n      try {\n        const entryHeaders = entry.headers ?? {}\n        const bridgedFrom = Object.entries(entryHeaders)\n          .find(([key]) => key.toLowerCase() === 'x-bridged-from')?.[1]\n        // W1 治理（契约 §6，CTO 裁决 2026-10-22）：导入入口自动入保险箱——敏感键值不落\n        // 业务集合，改经 SecretBroker 登记（服务记录只留非敏感头 + credentialRef）。\n        // 与 create/PATCH 的 400 门禁不同：导入多为连接器桥接的机器流程，拒绝会断链，\n        // 故采取「导入即迁移」语义；SecretBroker 未装配时回落存量明文行为（降级兼容）。\n        const plainKeys = sensitiveHeaderKeys(entryHeaders)\n        const keptHeaders = plainKeys.length > 0\n          ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(entryHeaders).filter(([key]) => !plainKeys.includes(key)))\n          : entryHeaders\n        let brokered = false\n        const service = this.createService({\n          name: entry.name,\n          endpoint: entry.url,\n          transport: entry.transport,\n          mode: 'external',\n          exec: 'real',\n          orgId: input.orgId,\n          owner: input.owner,\n          ...(Object.keys(keptHeaders).length > 0 ? { headers: keptHeaders } : {}),\n          // M0 数据面桥接打标：连接器网关导入的 MCP 服务带治理降级徽章（§2.11）\n          ...(bridgedFrom ? { bridgeFrom: String(bridgedFrom) } : {}),\n          ...(entry.description ? { description: entry.description } : {}),\n          tools: [],\n        })\n        if (plainKeys.length > 0 && this.secretBrokerRef) {\n          for (const key of plainKeys) {\n            this.secretBrokerRef.put({ serviceId: service.id, credentialRef: 'local:', headerName: key, secret: entryHeaders[key] })\n          }\n          this.services().update(service.id, { credentialRef: 'local:' })\n          brokered = true\n        }\n        let tools: McpToolSpec[] = []\n        let reachable = false\n        let message = ''\n        try {\n          // W1-T2 §6 注入点：自动发现同样经 SecretBroker 组装凭证头（新服务此刻通常无登记，miss 回落）\n          tools = await this.listRemoteTools(service.endpoint, await this.resolveCallHeaders(service))\n          reachable = true\n        } catch (error) {\n          message = t('工具自动发现失败：{reason}', { reason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) })\n        }\n        this.services().update(service.id, {\n          // 不可达时清空默认三件套，避免伪工具清单进入权限组\n          ...(reachable ? { tools } : { tools: [] as McpToolSpec[] }),\n          health: { lastProbeAt: now(), status: reachable ? 'healthy' : 'unknown', latencyMs: 0, consecutiveFails: 0, breakerOpen: false },\n        })\n        let status = service.status\n        if (reachable && input.autoDeploy !== false) {\n          try {\n            await this.verifyService(service.id)\n            const deployed = await this.deployService(service.id, { grayPercent: 100, changelog: 'mcpServers 配置导入自动发布', actor: input.owner })\n            status = deployed.status\n          } catch (error) {\n            message = `${message ? `${message}；` : ''}${t('自动发布失败：{reason}', { reason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) })}`\n          }\n        }\n        results.push({\n          name: entry.name, ok: true, slug: service.slug, serviceId: service.id,\n          tools: tools.length, reachable, status,\n          ...(brokered ? { brokered: true } : {}),\n          ...(message ? { error: message } : {}),\n        })\n      } catch (error) {\n        results.push({ name: entry.name, ok: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) })\n      }\n    }\n    return { imported: results.filter((item) => item.ok).length, results }\n  }\n\n  /** 测试环境验证：real 服务做真实 initialize 探测；demo 服务模拟探测。 */\n  async verifyService(id: string): Promise<McpServiceRecord> {\n    const service = this.requireService(id)\n    if (service.status !== 'draft') throw new Error(t('仅草稿状态可执行测试验证'))\n    this.services().update(id, { status: 'verifying' })\n    const latency = service.exec === 'real' ? await this.realProbe(service) : 200\n    if (latency < 0) {\n      this.services().update(id, { status: 'draft' })\n      throw new Error(t('测试验证失败：endpoint {endpoint} 不可达', { endpoint: service.endpoint }))\n    }\n    return this.services().update(id, { health: { lastProbeAt: now(), status: 'healthy', latencyMs: latency, consecutiveFails: 0, breakerOpen: false } })\n  }\n\n  /** 发布上线（可选灰度比例），记录版本。 */\n  async deployService(id: string, options: { grayPercent?: number; version?: string; changelog?: string; actor: string }): Promise<McpServiceRecord> {\n    const service = this.requireService(id)\n    if (!['draft', 'verifying', 'gray', 'online', 'unhealthy'].includes(service.status)) {\n      throw new Error(t('当前状态 {status} 不允许发布', { status: service.status }))\n    }\n    const version = options.version ?? bumpVersion(service.currentVersion)\n    const gray = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, options.grayPercent ?? 100))\n    await sleep(200)\n    const updated = this.services().update(id, {\n      status: gray >= 100 ? 'online' : 'gray',\n      grayPercent: gray,\n      currentVersion: version,\n      versions: [\n        ...service.versions.map((item) => ({ ...item, status: item.status === 'current' ? 'previous' : item.status })),\n        { version, changelog: options.changelog ?? t('例行更新'), publishedAt: now(), status: 'current' },\n      ],\n      health: { ...service.health, status: 'healthy', consecutiveFails: 0, breakerOpen: false },\n    })\n    this.ctx.platformBus.emit(PlatformEvents.McpDeployed, {\n      serviceId: id, name: updated.name, version, grayPercent: gray, actor: options.actor, type: 'mcp_service', slug: updated.slug,\n    })\n    return updated\n  }\n\n  async rollbackService(id: string, targetVersion: string, actor: string): Promise<McpServiceRecord> {\n    const service = this.requireService(id)\n    const target = service.versions.find((item) => item.version === targetVersion)\n    if (!target) throw new Error(t('目标版本不存在：{version}', { version: targetVersion }))\n    if (target.status === 'current') throw new Error(t('目标版本 {version} 即当前版本，无需回滚', { version: targetVersion }))\n    if (target.status === 'rolled-back') throw new Error(t('目标版本 {version} 已被回滚过，不允许作为回滚目标（版本不可变原则）', { version: targetVersion }))\n    const updated = this.services().update(id, {\n      currentVersion: targetVersion,\n      versions: service.versions.map((item) => ({\n        ...item,\n        status: item.version === targetVersion ? 'current' : item.status === 'current' ? 'rolled-back' : item.status,\n      })),\n    })\n    this.ctx.platformBus.emit(PlatformEvents.McpDeployed, {\n      serviceId: id, name: updated.name, version: targetVersion, rollback: true, actor, type: 'mcp_service', slug: updated.slug,\n    })\n    return updated\n  }\n\n  offlineService(id: string, actor: string, reason: string): McpServiceRecord {\n    const service = this.requireService(id)\n    if (service.status === 'offline') throw new Error(t('服务已是下线状态'))\n    const updated = this.services().update(id, { status: 'offline', grayPercent: 0 })\n    this.ctx.platformBus.emit(PlatformEvents.McpOfflined, { serviceId: id, name: updated.name, actor, reason, type: 'mcp_service', slug: updated.slug })\n    return updated\n  }\n\n  /** L4 下线走审批：创建审批单，通过后自动执行。 */\n  requestOfflineApproval(id: string, requester: { id: string; name: string }, reason: string, impactPreview: string[]) {\n    return this.ctx.audit.createApproval({\n      kind: 'mcp.offline',\n      // WP-10/L1（QA A-06）：L4 高危统一高风险——通过需二次确认 + 公司级终审标记\n      riskLevel: 'high',\n      title: t('下线 MCP 服务：{name}', { name: this.requireService(id).name }),\n      payload: { serviceId: id, reason, impactPreview },\n      requesterId: requester.id,\n      requesterName: requester.name,\n    })\n  }\n\n  /** 删除后的关联清理：远端会话与限流缓存、Broker 密钥文件一并清除；调用明细与审计数据保留。 */\n  purgeService(id: string): void {\n    const service = this.requireService(id)\n    this.mcpSessions.delete(service.endpoint)\n    for (const key of [...this.rateBuckets.keys()]) {\n      if (key.startsWith(`${id}:`)) this.rateBuckets.delete(key)\n    }\n    // W1-T2 §6：服务删除连带清除下游凭证文件（不落孤儿密钥）\n    try {\n      this.secretBrokerRef?.delete(id)\n    } catch { /* 单测宿主无数据目录等场景不阻断删除主流程 */ }\n    this.services().remove(id)\n  }\n\n  // -- 健康探活 -----------------------------------------------------------\n\n  async probeService(id: string): Promise<{ status: string; latencyMs: number }> {\n    const service = this.requireService(id)\n    if (service.status === 'offline' || service.status === 'draft') {\n      return { status: 'unknown', latencyMs: 0 }\n    }\n    // real：真实 HTTP 探测（POST initialize，测往返与延迟）；demo（含存量无标记）：确定性模拟\n    let latency: number\n    if (service.exec === 'real') {\n      latency = await this.realProbe(service)\n    } else {\n      latency = probeLatency(service)\n    }\n    const ok = latency > 0\n    const fails = ok ? 0 : service.health.consecutiveFails + 1\n    const breakerOpen = fails >= 3\n    const status = ok ? (latency > 800 ? 'degraded' : 'healthy') : 'down'\n    const update: McpServiceRecord = this.services().update(id, {\n      health: { lastProbeAt: now(), status, latencyMs: Math.max(0, latency), consecutiveFails: fails, breakerOpen },\n      ...(breakerOpen && service.status !== 'unhealthy' ? { status: 'unhealthy' } : {}),\n      ...(ok && service.status === 'unhealthy' ? { status: service.grayPercent >= 100 ? 'online' : 'gray' } : {}),\n    })\n    if (breakerOpen && service.status !== 'unhealthy') {\n      this.ctx.platformBus.emit(PlatformEvents.McpUnhealthy, {\n        serviceId: id, name: service.name, consecutiveFails: fails, latencyMs: latency,\n      })\n    }\n    return { status: update.health.status, latencyMs: latency }\n  }\n\n  private async probeAll(): Promise<void> {\n    for (const service of this.services().all()) {\n      if (service.status === 'offline' || service.status === 'draft') continue\n      try {\n        await this.probeService(service.id)\n      } catch (error) {\n        this.ctx.logger('mcp').warn('探活失败', service.id, error)\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** 业务失败计入熔断：真实调用失败与探活失败共用连续失败计数（连续 3 次开熔断）。 */\n  private noteBusinessFailure(service: McpServiceRecord, reason: string): void {\n    const fails = service.health.consecutiveFails + 1\n    const breakerOpen = fails >= 3\n    this.services().update(service.id, {\n      health: { ...service.health, lastProbeAt: now(), status: breakerOpen ? 'down' : 'degraded', consecutiveFails: fails, breakerOpen },\n      ...(breakerOpen && service.status !== 'unhealthy' ? { status: 'unhealthy' } : {}),\n    })\n    if (breakerOpen && service.status !== 'unhealthy') {\n      this.ctx.platformBus.emit(PlatformEvents.McpUnhealthy, {\n        serviceId: service.id, name: service.name, consecutiveFails: fails, latencyMs: 0,\n        reason: t('业务调用连续失败 {fails} 次：{reason}', { fails, reason }),\n      })\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** 业务成功即半闭合：清零失败计数、解除熔断（下次探活仍会复核）。 */\n  private noteBusinessSuccess(service: McpServiceRecord): void {\n    if (service.health.consecutiveFails === 0 && !service.health.breakerOpen) return\n    this.services().update(service.id, {\n      health: { ...service.health, status: 'healthy', consecutiveFails: 0, breakerOpen: false },\n      ...(service.status === 'unhealthy' ? { status: service.grayPercent >= 100 ? 'online' : 'gray' } : {}),\n    })\n  }\n\n  async healthCheck(id: string): Promise<{ status: string; latencyMs: number }> {\n    return this.probeService(id)\n  }\n\n  /** 真实探活：MCP initialize 握手，返回延迟（ms）；失败返回 -1。 */\n  private async realProbe(service: McpServiceRecord): Promise<number> {\n    const started = Date.now()\n    try {\n      // W1-T2 §6 注入点：探活与调用同源凭证（SecretBroker 组装，存量 headers 照旧）；\n      // W3-T5 §14：探活是周期性噪声源（长驻服务约 3千条/天/服务），访问留痕按窗口去重\n      const { payload } = await this.mcpRequest(service.endpoint, await this.resolveCallHeaders(service, { dedupKey: 'probe' }), {\n        jsonrpc: '2.0',\n        id: `probe-${Date.now()}`,\n        method: 'initialize',\n        params: { protocolVersion: '2025-03-26', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'dsh-ops-probe', version: '1.0' } },\n      }, REAL_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS)\n      if (payload?.error) return -1\n      return Date.now() - started\n    } catch {\n      return -1\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * MCP streamable HTTP 请求基座：单 POST JSON-RPC，兼容两种响应形态——纯 JSON 与\n   * SSE 流（text/event-stream，取首个 data 帧）；透传服务自定义头（如 Authorization），\n   * 回传服务端下发的 Mcp-Session-Id 供有状态服务复用。\n   */\n  private async mcpRequest(endpoint: string, headers: Record<string, string> | undefined, message: Record<string, unknown>, timeoutMs: number, sessionId?: string): Promise<{ payload: any; sessionId?: string; status?: number }> {\n    const controller = new AbortController()\n    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs)\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(endpoint, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'content-type': 'application/json',\n          accept: 'application/json, text/event-stream',\n          ...(sessionId ? { 'mcp-session-id': sessionId } : {}),\n          ...(headers ?? {}),\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(message),\n        signal: controller.signal,\n      })\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(t('MCP 服务 HTTP {status}：{body}', { status: response.status, body: (await response.text().catch(() => '')).slice(0, 200) }))\n      }\n      // 上游 HTTP 状态（W3-T5 §14 upstreamStatus 回填源；additive，既有调用方零感知）\n      const status = response.status\n      const sessionIdHeader = response.headers.get('mcp-session-id') ?? undefined\n      const contentType = String(response.headers.get('content-type') ?? '')\n      const text = await response.text()\n      if (contentType.includes('text/event-stream')) {\n        for (const line of text.split('\\n')) {\n          if (!line.startsWith('data:')) continue\n          const frame = line.slice(5).trim()\n          if (!frame || frame === '[DONE]') continue\n          try { return { payload: JSON.parse(frame), sessionId: sessionIdHeader, status } } catch { /* 跳过非 JSON 帧 */ }\n        }\n        throw new Error(t('MCP 服务 SSE 响应中未找到 JSON-RPC 帧'))\n      }\n      if (!text) return { payload: null, sessionId: sessionIdHeader, status } // 202 Accepted 等空体响应（通知类消息）\n      try {\n        return { payload: JSON.parse(text), sessionId: sessionIdHeader, status }\n      } catch {\n        throw new Error(t('MCP 服务响应不是合法 JSON：{body}', { body: text.slice(0, 200) }))\n      }\n    } finally {\n      clearTimeout(timer)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** 确立远端会话：initialize 握手并缓存 sessionId（无状态服务缓存 ''，避免每次重复握手）。 */\n  private async ensureSession(endpoint: string, headers?: Record<string, string>): Promise<string | undefined> {\n    const cached = this.mcpSessions.get(endpoint)\n    if (cached && cached.expiresAt > Date.now()) return cached.sessionId || undefined\n    const { payload, sessionId } = await this.mcpRequest(endpoint, headers, {\n      jsonrpc: '2.0',\n      id: `dsh-init-${Date.now()}`,\n      method: 'initialize',\n      params: { protocolVersion: '2025-03-26', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'dsh-ops-gateway', version: '1.0' } },\n    }, REAL_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS)\n    if (payload?.error) throw new Error(t('initialize 失败：{reason}', { reason: payload.error.message ?? t('未知错误') }))\n    const effective = sessionId ?? ''\n    this.mcpSessions.set(endpoint, { sessionId: effective, expiresAt: Date.now() + MCP_SESSION_TTL_MS })\n    if (effective) {\n      // 有状态服务要求补发 initialized 通知；无状态服务忽略即可，失败不阻断。\n      await this.mcpRequest(endpoint, headers, { jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'notifications/initialized' }, REAL_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS, effective).catch(() => undefined)\n    }\n    return effective || undefined\n  }\n\n  // -- 权限组 -------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  createPermGroup(input: {\n    name: string\n    description?: string\n    policies: Record<string, ToolPolicy>\n    subjects: McpPermGroupRecord['subjects']\n  }): McpPermGroupRecord {\n    if (!input.name?.trim()) throw new Error(t('权限组名称不能为空'))\n    if (this.permGroups().findOne((group) => group.name === input.name)) throw new Error(t('权限组已存在：{name}', { name: input.name }))\n    for (const serviceId of Object.keys(input.policies)) {\n      this.requireService(serviceId)\n    }\n    return this.permGroups().insert({\n      id: newId('mpg'),\n      name: input.name,\n      description: input.description ?? '',\n      policies: input.policies,\n      subjects: input.subjects,\n    })\n  }\n\n  updatePermGroup(id: string, patch: Partial<Pick<McpPermGroupRecord, 'name' | 'description' | 'policies' | 'subjects'>>): McpPermGroupRecord {\n    return this.permGroups().update(id, patch)\n  }\n\n  deletePermGroup(id: string): boolean {\n    return this.permGroups().remove(id)\n  }\n\n  /** 授予主体访问：加入权限组。 */\n  grantSubject(groupId: string, subject: McpPermGroupRecord['subjects'][number]): McpPermGroupRecord {\n    const group = this.permGroups().get(groupId)\n    if (!group) throw new Error(t('权限组不存在：{id}', { id: groupId }))\n    if (group.subjects.some((item) => item.type === subject.type && item.id === subject.id)) return group\n    return this.permGroups().update(groupId, { subjects: [...group.subjects, subject] })\n  }\n\n  // -- 资源限定 scope 模板 / 策略模拟（W3-T5，契约 §12/§14） ---------------------------------\n\n  /**\n   * scope 模板（契约 §12）：按权限组 policies 生成建议的资源限定 scope 集——\n   *   - allowedTools='*'（服务全量）→ 建议服务级 `mcp.service:<slug>.invoke`；\n   *   - allowedTools 白名单 → 逐工具 `mcp.tool:<slug>:<tool>.invoke`（readOnly 组不产出\n   *     write/admin 工具的 scope，模板与裁决面同判）；服务不存在/工具不在清单的引用跳过。\n   * dry 语义：只读推导，不落库不副作用；控制台（W3-T6）与「新增授权默认产出 scope 模板」消费。\n   */\n  scopeTemplate(groupId: string): {\n    scopes: string[]\n    byService: Array<{ serviceId: string; slug: string; scopes: string[] }>\n  } {\n    const group = this.permGroups().get(groupId)\n    if (!group) throw new Error(t('权限组不存在：{id}', { id: groupId }))\n    const byService: Array<{ serviceId: string; slug: string; scopes: string[] }> = []\n    const all = new Set<string>()\n    for (const [serviceId, policy] of Object.entries(group.policies)) {\n      const service = this.services().get(serviceId)\n      if (!service) continue\n      const scopes: string[] = []\n      if (policy.allowedTools === '*') {\n        scopes.push(`mcp.service:${service.slug}.invoke`)\n      } else {\n        for (const toolName of policy.allowedTools) {\n          const tool = service.tools.find((item) => item.name === toolName)\n          if (!tool) continue\n          // 只读约束组：写/admin 工具不产出 scope（模板=裁决面口径，避免模板越权误导）\n          if (policy.constraints.readOnly && (tool.riskLevel === 'write' || tool.riskLevel === 'admin')) continue\n          scopes.push(`mcp.tool:${service.slug}:${tool.name}.invoke`)\n        }\n      }\n      if (scopes.length === 0) continue\n      for (const scope of scopes) all.add(scope)\n      byService.push({ serviceId, slug: service.slug, scopes })\n    }\n    return { scopes: [...all], byService }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 策略模拟 / 影响分析（契约 §14）：body=完整权限组草稿，不落库——影响报告四维：\n   *   - newServices：policies 覆盖的服务（服务不存在引用跳过）；\n   *   - writeTools：覆盖服务中 allowedTools 命中的 riskLevel write/admin 工具；\n   *   - confidential：覆盖服务中 dataClass=confidential 的服务；\n   *   - crossOrg：服务 org 与 subjects 可达 org 已知且不一致（user_group 经成员展开、\n   *     agent/app 经 resourceCore 归属；org 缺失不可判 → 不计）；\n   *   - affectedSubjects：subjects 原样展开。\n   */\n  dryRunPermGroup(draft: {\n    name?: string\n    policies?: Record<string, ToolPolicy>\n    subjects?: McpPermGroupRecord['subjects']\n  }): {\n    newServices: Array<{ serviceId: string; slug: string; name: string }>\n    writeTools: Array<{ serviceId: string; slug: string; tool: string }>\n    confidential: Array<{ serviceId: string; slug: string; dataClass: string }>\n    crossOrg: boolean\n    affectedSubjects: McpPermGroupRecord['subjects']\n  } {\n    const policies = draft.policies ?? {}\n    const subjects = draft.subjects ?? []\n    const newServices: Array<{ serviceId: string; slug: string; name: string }> = []\n    const writeTools: Array<{ serviceId: string; slug: string; tool: string }> = []\n    const confidential: Array<{ serviceId: string; slug: string; dataClass: string }> = []\n    const serviceOrgs = new Set<string>()\n    for (const [serviceId, policy] of Object.entries(policies)) {\n      const service = this.services().get(serviceId)\n      if (!service) continue\n      newServices.push({ serviceId, slug: service.slug, name: service.name })\n      if (service.orgId) serviceOrgs.add(service.orgId)\n      if ((service.dataClass ?? 'internal') === 'confidential') {\n        confidential.push({ serviceId, slug: service.slug, dataClass: service.dataClass })\n      }\n      for (const tool of service.tools) {\n        if (tool.riskLevel !== 'write' && tool.riskLevel !== 'admin') continue\n        const granted = policy.allowedTools === '*' || policy.allowedTools.includes(tool.name)\n        if (granted) writeTools.push({ serviceId, slug: service.slug, tool: tool.name })\n      }\n    }\n    // subjects 可达组织：任一（服务org × 主体org）已知且不同 → crossOrg\n    let crossOrg = false\n    for (const subject of subjects) {\n      const orgs = this.subjectReachableOrgs(subject)\n      if (orgs.size === 0) continue\n      for (const serviceOrg of serviceOrgs) {\n        if (!orgs.has(serviceOrg)) crossOrg = true\n      }\n    }\n    return { newServices, writeTools, confidential, crossOrg, affectedSubjects: subjects }\n  }\n\n  /** 主体可达组织集合（dry-run crossOrg 判定）：user_group 经 iam 成员展开；agent/app 经 resourceCore 归属；不可解析=空集（不计）。 */\n  private subjectReachableOrgs(subject: McpPermGroupRecord['subjects'][number]): Set<string> {\n    const orgs = new Set<string>()\n    try {\n      if (subject.type === 'user_group') {\n        for (const member of this.ctx.iam.resolveGroupMembers(subject.id)) {\n          const orgId = (member as { orgId?: string }).orgId\n            ?? (this.ctx.iam as { users?: () => { get: (id: string) => { orgId?: string } | undefined } }).users?.().get(member.id)?.orgId\n          if (orgId) orgs.add(orgId)\n        }\n        return orgs\n      }\n      const core = (this.ctx as unknown as { resourceCore?: { get: (kind: string, id: string) => { orgId?: string } | undefined } }).resourceCore\n      const orgId = core?.get(subject.type, subject.id)?.orgId\n      if (orgId) orgs.add(orgId)\n    } catch { /* 解析失败按空集（不可判不计） */ }\n    return orgs\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 权限组主体匹配（W2-T3 契约 §8 抽取）：返回命中该 caller 的全部服务策略。\n   * 主体三类：user_group（human 经 iam 用户组解析）/ agent / app；多组命中时由\n   * decideTool 依 grants 顺序逐一裁决（与既有 authorize 行为一致，抽取非复制）。\n   */\n  private matchedPolicies(caller: InvokeCaller, serviceId: string): ToolPolicy[] {\n    const grants: ToolPolicy[] = []\n    // 可匹配主体集合：caller.subjects（主体 + 委托链 actor，additive）缺省时回落主体自身\n    const subjectPool: Array<{ type: 'user' | 'agent' | 'app'; id: string }> = caller.subjects?.length\n      ? caller.subjects\n      : [{ type: caller.type, id: caller.id }]\n    for (const group of this.permGroups().all()) {\n      const policy = group.policies[serviceId]\n      if (!policy) continue\n      const hit = group.subjects.some((subject) => {\n        if (subject.type === 'user_group') {\n          // 用户组主体：任一 pool 内的真人命中组成员即算命中\n          return subjectPool.some((candidate) => candidate.type === 'user'\n            && this.ctx.iam.resolveGroupMembers(subject.id).some((user) => user.id === candidate.id))\n        }\n        return subjectPool.some((candidate) => subject.type === candidate.type && subject.id === candidate.id)\n      })\n      if (hit) grants.push(policy)\n    }\n    return grants\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 单工具裁决（W2-T3 契约 §8 抽取）：authorize() 与 authorizedToolsFor() 共用同一判定——\n   * 按 grants 顺序取首个 allowedTools 命中的策略定裁决；只读语境拦截 write/admin。\n   * W1/V11 只读约束口径（与工作策略端口同判）：unknown 按只读语境放行（未登记工具在\n   * 只读语境下视为 read——写能力已被写语境拒绝面兜住，残余风险由重审清单 reviewList 收敛，\n   * 不再「未知即拒」误伤只读消费）。\n   */\n  private decideTool(grants: ToolPolicy[], tool: McpToolSpec): { ok: true; readOnly: boolean } | { ok: false; reason: string /** 授权检查：返回可用的策略上下文或拒绝原因。 */\n  authorize(caller: InvokeCaller, serviceId: string, toolName: string): { ok: true; readOnly: boolean } | { ok: false; reason: string } {\n    const service = service.name, tool: toolName }) }\n    const grants = this.matchedPolicies(caller, serviceId)\n    if (grants.length === 0) {\n      return { ok: false, reason: t('主体 {name} 未被任何 MCP 权限组授权访问 {service}', { name: caller.name, service: service.name }) }\n    }\n    return this.decideTool(grants, tool)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 可调用工具集合（W2-T3 契约 §8 新导出）：当前身份在该服务可调用的工具名列表——\n   * 权限组主体匹配 + allowedTools 交集 + readOnly 约束过滤 write/admin 工具，与 authorize()\n   * 单工具判定完全同源（matchedPolicies/decideTool 共用，行为等价）。\n   * 无权限组/无命中 → 空数组（服务级 tools/list 据此回空集，未授权工具一概不出现；\n   * 高敏数据类的 ABAC 收敛在 W3-T5 PDP 落地，本集合按权限组 fail-closed 已满足\n   * 「无授权不出现」验收口径）。服务级端点 tools/list 与 tools/call 一致性都以此为边界。\n   */\n  authorizedToolsFor(caller: InvokeCaller, service: McpServiceRecord): string[] {\n    const grants = this.matchedPolicies(caller, service.id)\n    if (grants.length === 0) return []\n    return service.tools.filter((tool) => this.decideTool(grants, tool).ok).map((tool) => tool.name)\n  }\n\n  // -- 主裁决 PDP（W3-T5，契约 §11/§12/§13） ---------------------------------\n  //\n  // MCP invoke 主裁决收敛进 PolicyDecisionPoint：authorize() 的权限组判定迁入\n  // mcp-permgroup 模块（matchedPolicies/decideTool 风险写语境拒绝）四个模块。模块序与既有\n  // 闸门序一致：scope → 权限组 → 场景 → 组织 → 风险；首个 deny 模块的理由即主因\n  // （既有领域拒绝文案不漂移），deny 码经 denyCodeOf 映射领域码。\n\n  /** 网关 PDP 实例（懒构建；模块注册序即裁决序，见各模块注释）。 */\n  private gatewayPdp: PolicyDecisionPoint | undefined\n\n  private pdp(): PolicyDecisionPoint {\n    if (this.gatewayPdp) return this.gatewayPdp\n    const pdp = new PolicyDecisionPoint()\n    pdp.register(this.iamPermissionModule())\n    pdp.register(this.mcpPermGroupModule())\n    pdp.register(this.sceneModule())\n    pdp.register(this.orgConstraintModule())\n    pdp.register(this.riskGateModule())\n    this.gatewayPdp = pdp\n    return pdp\n  }\n\n  /** 判定面主体投影：InvokeCaller → UnifiedPrincipal 最小形态（PDP 契约类型要求；scopes/组织等事实随 req.context 携带）。 */\n  private subjectOf(caller: InvokeCaller): UnifiedPrincipal {\n    const kind = caller.type === 'user' ? 'human' as const : caller.type === 'agent' ? 'agent' as const : 'app' as const\n    return {\n      principalId: caller.id,\n      kind,\n      ...(caller.type === 'user' ? { userId: caller.id } : caller.type === 'agent' ? { agentId: caller.id } : { appId: caller.id }),\n      ...(caller.orgId !== undefined ? { orgId: caller.orgId } : {}),\n      ...(caller.tenantId !== undefined ? { tenantId: caller.tenantId } : {}),\n      ...(caller.subjectUserId !== undefined ? { subjectUserId: caller.subjectUserId } : {}),\n      authMethod: 'client-credentials',\n      tokenId: '',\n      scopes: [...(caller.scopes ?? [])],\n      actChain: (caller.actChain ?? []).map((entry, index) => ({ kind: entry.type === 'human' ? 'user' as const : 'platform-service' as const, id: `${caller.id}#${index}`, name: entry.name })),\n      name: caller.name,\n      permissions: [...(caller.scopes ?? [])],\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 第一层 iam-permission（契约 §12）：unified.scopes 含 mcp.invoke（全局）或\n   * mcp.service:<本服务>.invoke / mcp.tool:<本服务>:<本工具>.invoke 任一即过第一层；\n   * '*' 平台主体直通。 scopes 未随调用携带（legacy 工具面调用方）fail-open——第一层\n   * 不设防，第二层权限组照旧强制；scopes 已携带且声明了 MCP scope 面（任一 mcp. 前缀）\n   * 却未覆盖本目标时 fail-closed（SCOPE_DENIED）——资源限定令牌被限定到别的服务/工具时\n   * 显式拒绝，而非靠第二层文案含混放行。scope 放行不绕过权限组（第二层仍强制）。\n   */\n  private iamPermissionModule(): PolicyModule {\n    return {\n      id: 'iam-permission',\n      decide: (req) => {\n        const scopes = req.context.scopes as string[] | undefined\n        if (!scopes || scopes.length === 0) {\n          return { allow: true, reasons: ['令牌 scopes 未随调用携带（legacy 调用方），第一层不设防'], decisionId: newId('pd'), obligations: [] }\n        }\n        if (scopes.includes('*') || scopes.includes('mcp.invoke')) {\n          return { allow: true, reasons: ['令牌 scopes 含 MCP 调用授权'], decisionId: newId('pd'), obligations: [] }\n        }\n        const serviceSlug = String(req.context.serviceSlug ?? '')\n        const toolName = String(req.tool?.name ?? '')\n        const serviceScope = `mcp.service:${serviceSlug}.invoke`\n        const toolScope = `mcp.tool:${serviceSlug}:${toolName}.invoke`\n        if (scopes.includes(serviceScope) || scopes.includes(toolScope)) {\n          return { allow: true, reasons: [`令牌含资源限定 scope（${scopes.includes(serviceScope) ? serviceScope : toolScope}）`], decisionId: newId('pd'), obligations: [] }\n        }\n        // 声明了 MCP scope 面但未覆盖本目标：fail-closed（资源限定语义的正确拒绝面）\n        const declaredMcp = scopes.filter((scope) => scope.startsWith('mcp.'))\n        if (declaredMcp.length === 0) {\n          return { allow: true, reasons: ['令牌未声明 MCP scope 面（legacy scopes），第一层不设防'], decisionId: newId('pd'), obligations: [] }\n        }\n        return this.denyDecision('SCOPE_DENIED', t('令牌 scopes 未授权调用本服务/工具：须含 mcp.invoke 或 mcp.service:{slug}.invoke / mcp.tool:{slug}:{tool}.invoke', { slug: serviceSlug, tool: toolName }))\n      },\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 第二层 mcp-permgroup（契约 §11：既有 authorize() 逻辑迁入，行为等价）：判定面\n   * 与 authorize()/authorizedToolsFor() 完全同源（matchedPolicies 主体匹配 +\n   * decideTool 单工具裁决），拒绝文案逐字保持既有领域文案；放行时产出 read-only\n   * 义务（供审计展示，本波不新增执行语义）。\n   */\n  private mcpPermGroupModule(): PolicyModule {\n    return {\n      id: 'mcp-permgroup',\n      decide: (req) => {\n        const caller = req.context.caller as InvokeCaller\n        const service = req.context.service as McpServiceRecord\n        const toolName = String(req.tool?.name ?? '')\n        // 工具存在性：与 authorize() 首查同文案（服务清单是裁决边界，未知工具不泄露）\n        const tool = service.tools.find((item) => item.name === toolName)\n        if (!tool) {\n          return { allow: false, reasons: [t('服务 {service} 不存在工具 {tool}', { service: service.name, tool: toolName })], decisionId: newId('pd'), obligations: [] }\n        }\n        const grants = this.matchedPolicies(caller, service.id)\n        if (grants.length === 0) {\n          return { allow: false, reasons: [t('主体 {name} 未被任何 MCP 权限组授权访问 {service}', { name: caller.name, service: service.name })], decisionId: newId('pd'), obligations: [] }\n        }\n        const verdict = this.decideTool(grants, tool)\n        if (!verdict.ok) {\n          return { allow: false, reasons: [verdict.reason], decisionId: newId('pd'), obligations: [] }\n        }\n        return {\n          allow: true,\n          reasons: ['MCP 权限组授权命中'],\n          decisionId: newId('pd'),\n          // 只读约束转化为结构化义务（契约 §11 obligations；供审计展示）\n          obligations: verdict.readOnly ? [{ type: 'read-only' }] : [],\n        }\n      },\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 场景 ABAC 模块（契约 §11 scene-ABAC）：仅当调用上下文显式携带 sceneCode 且\n   * ctx.iam.checkScene 可达时接入（deny 优先 fail-closed，与 iam 判定同源）；\n   * 两者任一缺席即跳过（注释口径：独立单测宿主/legacy 调用方无场景语义，行为零漂移）。\n   */\n  private sceneModule(): PolicyModule {\n    return {\n      id: 'scene',\n      decide: (req) => {\n        const sceneCode = req.context.sceneCode as string | undefined\n        const iam = this.ctx.iam as { checkScene?: (userId: string, sceneCode: string, action: string) => { decision: string; reason: string } } | undefined\n        if (!sceneCode || typeof iam?.checkScene !== 'function') {\n          return { allow: true, reasons: ['未指定场景码或 iam.checkScene 不可达，场景 ABAC 跳过'], decisionId: newId('pd'), obligations:  if (!entity || (entity.type !== 'app' && entity.type !== 'agent') || !entity.id) return undefined\n    try {\n      const core = (this.ctx as unknown as { resourceCore?: { get: (kind: string, id: org 来自 iam；解析失败返回 undefined 不判）。 */\n  private subjectUserOrg(userId: string): string | undefined {\n    try {\n      const iam = this.ctx.iam as { users?: () => { get: (id: string) => { orgId?: } catch {\n      return false\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** 跨组织/租户拒绝的统一出口：领域码经 deny-code 义务随决策携带（供拒绝响应 data.code 映射）。 */\n  private orgScopeDenied(reason: string): PolicyDecision {\n    return { allow: false, ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 服务\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport class UhpGatewayService extends Service {\n  static readonly provide = 'uhpGateway'\n\n  /** 执行中任务的取消登记（taskId → responseId）。 */\n  private inflight = new Map<string, string>()\n  /** 取消标记（responseId → true）：模型调用返回后据此丢弃结果（协作取消语义）。 */\n  private cancelRequested = new Set<string>()\n\n  constructor(ctx: Context) {\n    super(ctx, 'uhpGateway')\n    // A2A 派发联动（只走事件总线纪律）：收到派发事件后异步启动执行——\n    // 监听器本身立即返回（总线监听器 5s 超时），长任务在独立 Promise 中推进。\n    ctx.platformBus.on('a2a.task.dispatch', (payload) => {\n      const p = payload as UhpDispatchPayload\n      void this.executeForTask(p).catch((error) => {\n        this.ctx.logger('uhp').error('UHP 执行派发处理异常', error)\n      })\n    })\n    // 取消联动：A2A tasks/cancel → UHP cancel（协议面）+ 响应作废标记\n    ctx.platformBus.on('a2a.task.cancel', (payload) => {\n      const p = payload as { taskId: string; reason?: string }\n      const responseId = this.inflight.get(p.taskId)\n      if (responseId) {\n        this.cancelRequested.add(responseId)\n        this.responses().update(responseId, { status: 'canceled', canceledAt: new Date().toISOString() })\n      } else {\n        // 无在途执行：找最近一条该任务的 response 标记取消（诚实幂等：已终态不覆盖）\n        const existing = [...this.responses().find((item) => item.taskId === p.taskId)].pop()\n        if (existing && (existing.status === 'queued' || existing.status === 'in_progress')) {\n          this.responses().update(existing.id, { status: 'canceled', canceledAt: new Date().toISOString() })\n        }\n      }\n    })\n  }\n\n  // -- 集合 -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  harnesses(): Collection<UhpHarnessRecord> {\n    return this.ctx.opsStorage.collection<UhpHarnessRecord>('uhp:harnesses', { durability: 'durable' })\n  }\n\n  responses(): Collection<UhpResponseRecord> {\n    return this.ctx.opsStorage.collection<UhpResponseRecord>('uhp:responses', { durability: 'durable' })\n  }\n\n  // -- harness 注册表 --------------------------------------------------------\n\n  upsertHarness(input: {\n    id?: string\n    agentId: string\n    model: string\n    channelGroup?: string\n    toolPermGroupIds?: string[]\n    stepBudget?: number\n    timeBudgetMs?: number\n    dataClassCeiling?: DataClass\n    enabled?: boolean\n    createdBy: string\n  }): UhpHarnessRecord {\n    const agent = this.ctx.resourceCore.get('agent', input.agentId)\n    if (!agent) throw new Error(t('Agent 不存在：{id}（harness 必须绑定真实 Agent 资产）', { id: input.agentId }))\n    if (!input.model.trim()) throw new Error(t('model 必填（harness 执行的模型 slug）'))\n    const ceiling = input.dataClassCeiling ?? 'internal'\n    if (!(ceiling in DATA_CLASS_RANK)) throw new Error(t('dataClassCeiling 非法：{value}（public/internal/secret）', { value: ceiling }))\n    const stepBudget = input.stepBudget ?? 8\n    const timeBudgetMs = input.timeBudgetMs ?? 120_000\n    if (!(stepBudget > 0) || stepBudget > 64) throw new Error(t('stepBudget 须在 1-64 之间'))\n    if (!(timeBudgetMs >= 5_000) || timeBudgetMs > 600_000) throw new Error(t('timeBudgetMs 须在 5000-600000 毫秒之间'))\n    const existing = input.id ? this.harnesses().get(input.id) : undefined\n    if (existing) {\n      return this.harnesses().update(existing.id, {\n        agentId: input.agentId,\n        model: input.model,\n        ...(input.channelGroup !== undefined ? { channelGroup: input.channelGroup } : {}),\n        toolPermGroupIds: input.toolPermGroupIds ?? existing.toolPermGroupIds,\n        stepBudget,\n        timeBudgetMs,\n        dataClassCeiling: ceiling,\n        ...(input.enabled !== undefined ? { enabled: input.enabled } : { enabled: existing.enabled }),\n      })\n    }\n    const id = input.id?.trim() || newId('uhp')\n    if (this.harnesses().get(id)) throw new Error(t('harness id 已存在：{id}', { id }))\n    return this.harnesses().insert({\n      id,\n      agentId: input.agentId,\n      model: input.model,\n      ...(input.channelGroup ? { channelGroup: input.channelGroup } : {}),\n      toolPermGroupIds: input.toolPermGroupIds ?? [],\n      stepBudget,\n      timeBudgetMs,\n      dataClassCeiling: ceiling,\n      enabled: input.enabled ?? true,\n      createdBy: input.createdBy,\n    })\n  }\n\n  removeHarness(id: string): boolean {\n    return this.harnesses().remove(id)\n  }\n\n  /** 能力发现（GET /v1/uhp）：configured harness 清单按 runtime 视角呈现。 */\n  discovery(): {\n    uhp_version: string\n    conformance_class: string\n    capabilities: { files_input: boolean; files_output: boolean; session_listing: boolean; session_sharing: boolean; harness_management: boolean }\n    harnesses: Array<{ id: string; configured: string[] }>\n  } {\n    const onlineAgents = new Map(this.ctx.resourceCore.list('agent').filter((item) => item.status === 'online').map((item) => [item.id, item.slug]))\n    const byHarnessId = new Map<string, string[]>()\n    for (const harness of this.harnesses().all()) {\n      if (!harness.enabled) continue\n      const slug = onlineAgents.get(harness.agentId)\n      if (!slug) continue\n      byHarnessId.set(harness.id, [slug])\n    }\n    return {\n      uhp_version: UHP_VERSION,\n      conformance_class: UHP_CONFORMANCE_CLASS,\n      capabilities: {\n        files_input: false,\n        files_output: false,\n        session_listing: true,\n        session_sharing: false,\n        harness_management: false,\n      },\n      harnesses: [...byHarnessId.entries()].map(([id, configured]) => ({ id, configured })),\n    }\n  }\n\n  // -- 任务面 ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  /**\n   * 创建并启动一次 UHP 执行（幂等）：同 Idempotency-Key 的既有终态记录原样重放，\n   * 在途记录直接返回（不重复执行）。返回 response 记录。\n   *\n   * P0（Q-1）任务绑定收口：`taskId` 仅接受平台 A2A 派发路径（`dispatchedByPlatform: true`）传入，\n   * 服务层 fail-closed 兜底——即便未来有人从协议面误传 taskId，也不会建立任务归属。\n   */\n  async createResponse(input: {\n    harnessRef?: string\n    agentId: string\n    inputText: string\n    dataClass?: DataClass\n    previousResponseId?: string\n    idempotencyKey?: string\n    taskId?: string\n    contextId?: string\n    sessionPolicy?: 'task-bound' | 'employee-bound'\n    callerPrincipalId: string\n    callerName?: string\n    callerKind?: 'machine' | 'human' | 'system'\n    actChain?: Array<{ principalId: string; name: string; type: string }>\n    dispatchedByPlatform?: boolean\n    onBehalfUser?: string\n    requestTools?: unknown\n    requestFunctions?: unknown\n    requestMcpServers?: unknown\n    negotiationNote?: string\n  }): Promise<UhpResponseRecord> {\n    if (!input.inputText?.trim()) throw new Error(t('input 必填（UHP 任务输入不能为空）'))\n    const dispatched = input.dispatchedByPlatform === true\n    // P0（Q-1）：任务绑定只认平台派发路径——非派发调用携带 taskId 一律拒绝（fail-closed）\n    if (input.taskId && !dispatched) {\n      throw new UhpBindingError(t('外部调用不得绑定 A2A 任务：ybk_a2a_task_id 仅允许由平台内部派发通道注入'))\n    }\n    // 幂等：同键重放返回原记录（协作方案 §7.2——跨节点重试不会重复执行也不会双计）\n    if (input.idempotencyKey) {\n      const existing = this.responses().find((item) => item.idempotencyKey === input.idempotencyKey)\n      const latest = existing.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt))[0]\n      if (latest) return latest\n    }\n    const agent = this.ctx.resourceCore.get('agent', input.agentId)\n    if (!agent) throw new Error(t('Agent 不存在：{id}', { id: input.agentId }))\n    if (agent.status !== 'online') throw new Error(t('Agent 未上线（{status}），UHP 仅对 online 执行体开放', { status: agent.status }))\n    const harness = this.resolveHarness(agent, input.harnessRef)\n    const requested: DataClass = input.dataClass ?? 'internal'\n    if (DATA_CLASS_RANK[requested] > DATA_CLASS_RANK[harness.dataClassCeiling]) {\n      throw new Error(t('数据密级越级：请求 {requested} 高于 harness 天花板 {ceiling}（渠道锁死拒绝口径）', { requested, ceiling: harness.dataClassCeiling }))\n    }\n    // 越权原语封堵：请求级 tools/functions/mcp_servers 一律接受但不生效，留痕 ignored_fields（协作方案 §7.2）\n    const ignoredFields: string[] = []\n    if (input.requestTools !== undefined) ignoredFields.push('tools')\n    if (input.requestFunctions !== undefined) ignoredFields.push('functions')\n    if (input.requestMcpServers !== undefined) ignoredFields.push('mcp_servers')\n    // 会话续接（Q-23）：继承上一响应的 sessionId（使 session_id 成为可靠归组键），\n    // 并把上一轮 assistant 回答回填进上下文——否则被调方「不知道自己上一轮说了什么」\n    let messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }> = []\n    let inheritedSessionId = ''\n    if (input.previousResponseId) {\n      const prev = this.responses().get(input.previousResponseId)\n      if (!prev) throw new Error(t('previous_response_id 不存在：{id}', { id: input.previousResponseId }))\n      if (prev.agentId !== agent.id) throw new Error(t('previous_response_id 属于其他执行体，拒绝跨 harness 会话续接'))\n      // 归属校验（Q-3 纵深）：会话续接仅限记录属主或其组织内持 uhp.read 的治理视图\n      this.assertResponseAccess(prev, input.callerPrincipalId, ['uhp.read'])\n      inheritedSessionId = prev.sessionId\n      messages = JSON.parse(prev.messagesJson) as Array<{ role: string; content: string }>\n      if (prev.outputText) messages = [...messages, { role: 'assistant', content: prev.outputText }]\n    }\n    const sessionPolicy = input.sessionPolicy ?? 'task-bound'\n    const sessionId = sessionPolicy === 'task-bound'\n      ? (input.taskId ?? (inheritedSessionId || newId('uhpsess')))\n      : `emp:${agent.id}:${input.callerPrincipalId}`\n    const systemPrompt = this.systemPromptFor(agent)\n    if (!messages.some((item) => item.role === 'system')) messages = [{ role: 'system', content: systemPrompt }, ...messages]\n    messages = [...messages, { role: 'user', content: input.negotiationNote ? `${input.inputText}\\n\\n（协商附注：${input.negotiationNote}）` : input.inputText }]\n    const record = this.responses().insert({\n      id: newId('resp'),\n      harnessId: harness.id,\n      agentId: agent.id,\n      sessionId,\n      sessionPolicy,\n      ...(input.previousResponseId ? { previousResponseId: input.previousResponseId } : {}),\n      status: 'queued',\n      messagesJson: JSON.stringify(messages),\n      outputText: '',\n      inputTokens: 0,\n      outputTokens: 0,\n      model: harness.model,\n      dataClass: requested,\n      ...(input.taskId ? { taskId: input.taskId } : {}),\n      ...(input.contextId ? { contextId: input.contextId } : {}),\n      ...(input.idempotencyKey ? { idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey } : {}),\n      callerPrincipalId: input.callerPrincipalId,\n      callerName: input.callerName ?? input.callerPrincipalId,\n      callerKind: input.callerKind ?? (dispatched ? 'system' : 'machine'),\n      actChainJson: JSON.stringify(input.actChain ?? []),\n      ...(input.onBehalfUser ? { onBehalfUser: input.onBehalfUser } : {}),\n      dispatchedByPlatform: dispatched,\n      metadataJson: JSON.stringify({\n        ybk_agent_id: agent.id,\n        ...(input.taskId ? { ybk_a2a_task_id: input.taskId } : {}),\n        ybk_data_class: requested,\n        ...(input.onBehalfUser ? { ybk_on_behalf_user: input.onBehalfUser } : {}),\n        ignored_fields: ignoredFields,\n      }),\n    })\n    this.run(record.id).catch((error) => {\n      this.ctx.logger('uhp').error(`UHP 执行异常（response=${record.id}）`, error)\n    })\n    return record\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行记录归属校验（Q-3）：属主本人、`*`，或持列出的治理读权限点者方可读/取消。\n   * 同层外部集成之间不得互相读取输入输出内容或取消在途执行（DoS + 数据泄露防护）。\n   */\n  private assertResponseAccess(record: UhpResponseRecord, principalId: string, overridePoints: string[]): void {\n    if (record.callerPrincipalId === principalId) return\n    throw new ForbiddenError(t('无权访问该执行记录（仅属主或持治理读权限者可访问）'))\n    void overridePoints // 治理读权限点在 HTTP 层校验（CallerInfo.scopes 可见），服务层只认归属\n  }\n\n  response(id: string): UhpResponseRecord | undefined {\n    return this.responses().get(id)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 取消：终态诚实拒绝；在途执行标记取消，模型返回后结果不交付。\n   * 归属校验（Q-3）：非属主不得取消他人执行记录（同层凭证间互不干扰）。\n   */\n  cancelResponse(id: string, reason: string, callerPrincipalId: string): UhpResponseRecord {\n    const record = this.responses().get(id)\n    if (!record) throw new Error(t('response 不存在：{id}', { id }))\n    this.assertResponseAccess(record, callerPrincipalId, [])\n    if (['completed', 'failed', 'canceled'].includes(record.status)) {\n      throw new Error(t('response 已终态（{status}），不可取消', { status: record.status }))\n    }\n    this.cancelRequested.add(id)\n    return this.responses().update(id, { status: 'canceled', canceledAt: new Date().toISOString(), error: reason })\n  }\n\n  /** 解析 harness：显式引用 → 注册表；未注册 → 从 Agent attrs 投影的临时配置（不改协作面行为）。 */\n  private resolveHarness(agent: { id: string; attrs: Record<string, unknown> }, harnessRef?: string): UhpHarnessRecord {\n    const ref = String(harnessRef ?? agent.attrs['uhpHarnessRef'] ?? '').trim()\n    if (ref) {\n      const found = this.harnesses().get(ref)\n      if (!found) throw new Error(t('uhpHarnessRef 指向的 harness 不存在：{id}（请先在 UHP 注册或清空该引用）', { id: ref }))\n      if (!found.enabled) throw new Error(t('harness 已停用：{id}', { id: ref }))\n      return found\n    }\n    const model = String(agent.attrs['model'] ?? '').trim()\n    if (!model) throw new Error(t('Agent 未配置模型（model 属性为空），无法执行'))\n    const ceilingRaw = String(agent.attrs['a2aDataClassCeiling'] ?? 'internal')\n    const ceiling: DataClass = ceilingRaw in DATA_CLASS_RANK ? (ceilingRaw as DataClass) : 'internal'\n    return {\n      id: `adhoc:${agent.id}`,\n      agentId: agent.id,\n      model,\n      toolPermGroupIds: [],\n      stepBudget: 1,\n      timeBudgetMs: 120_000,\n      dataClassCeiling: ceiling,\n      enabled: true,\n      createdBy: 'system',\n      createdAt: '',\n      updatedAt: '',\n    }\n  }\n\n  private systemPromptFor(agent: { name: string; attrs: Record<string, unknown> }): string {\n    const custom = String(agent.attrs['systemPrompt'] ?? '').trim()\n    if (custom) return custom\n    return t('你是企业数字同事「{name}」。{description}', { name: agent.name, description: String(agent.attrs['description'] ?? '') })\n  }\n\n  /** A2A 派发入口：包装 createResponse（唯一允许绑定 taskId 的通道），终态经总线回传（a2a.task.progress）。 */\n  private async executeForTask(payload: UhpDispatchPayload): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      const record = await this.createResponse({\n        agentId: payload.agentId,\n        harnessRef: payload.harnessRef,\n        inputText: payload.input,\n        dataClass: payload.dataClass,\n        idempotencyKey: payload.idempotencyKey,\n        taskId: payload.taskId,\n        contextId: payload.contextId,\n        sessionPolicy: payload.sessionPolicy,\n        callerPrincipalId: payload.callerPrincipalId,\n        callerKind: 'system',\n        callerName: payload.callerPrincipalId,\n        ...(payload.actChain ? { actChain: payload.actChain } : {}),\n        // P0（Q-1）：仅平台派发路径置 true——这是外部调用无法伪造的绑定凭据\n        dispatchedByPlatform: true,\n        onBehalfUser: payload.onBehalfUser,\n        negotiationNote: payload.negotiationNote,\n      })\n      if (record.status === 'queued' || record.status === 'in_progress') {\n        // 等待终态（run 里的 promise 不在这里 await——由 progress 事件驱动 A2A 侧状态机）\n        await this.awaitTerminal(record.id, payload.taskId)\n      } else {\n        // 幂等重放：把既有终态原样回传（A2A 侧据此收敛状态）\n        this.emitProgress(record, record.status === 'completed' ? 'completed' : record.status === 'canceled' ? 'canceled' : 'failed')\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n      this.ctx.platformBus.emit('a2a.task.progress', {\n        taskId: payload.taskId,\n        responseId: '',\n        phase: 'failed',\n        error: reason,\n      } satisfies UhpProgressPayload)\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** 等待单条 response 终态（轮询轻量实现——执行体同进程，300ms 粒度足够）。 */\n  private async awaitTerminal(responseId: string, taskId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    for (let i = 0; i < 4000; i++) {\n      const record = this.responses().get(responseId)\n      if (!record) return\n      if (['completed', 'failed', 'canceled'].includes(record.status)) {\n        this.emitProgress(record, record.status === 'completed' ? 'completed' : record.status === 'canceled' ? 'canceled' : 'failed')\n        return\n      }\n      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300))\n    }\n    // 兜底超时：标记失败（时间预算守卫，不悬挂调用方）\n    if (taskId) {\n      this.responses().update(responseId, { status: 'failed', error: t('执行超时（时间预算耗尽）') })\n      this.emitProgress(this.responses().get(responseId)!, 'failed')\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 进度回传：所有执行记录都发 `uhp.response.progress`（SSE 订阅面，P2-03 闭合外部直调流），\n   * 但只有「平台 A2A 派发」记录才额外发 `a2a.task.progress` 驱动 A2A 状态机（P0 Q-1 核心闸门）。\n   * 外部直调（dispatchedByPlatform=false）永不发出 a2a.task.progress——\n   * 从根上杜绝「外部凭证借执行结果把他人任务推到终态」的劫持路径。\n   */\n  private emitProgress(record: UhpResponseRecord | undefined, phase: UhpProgressPayload['phase']): void {\n    if (!record) return\n    if (record.taskId) this.inflight.delete(record.taskId)\n    const payload = {\n      taskId: record.taskId,\n      responseId: record.id,\n      phase,\n      ...(phase === 'completed' ? { text: record.outputText } : {}),\n      ...(record.error ? { error: record.error } : {}),\n      inputTokens: record.inputTokens,\n      outputTokens: record.outputTokens,\n      model: record.model,\n    } satisfies UhpProgressPayload\n    // 执行记录事件（与任务事件分离）：内部直调/外部直调/平台派发统一可订阅——\n    // 它不驱动任何 A2A 状态，因此不扩大 P0 攻击面（a2a.task.progress 的闸门保持不变）。\n    this.ctx.platformBus.emit('uhp.response.progress', payload)\n    if (!record.dispatchedByPlatform) return\n    this.ctx.platformBus.emit('a2a.task.progress', payload)\n  }\n\n  /** 真实执行体（内置 dsh harness）：单步真实模型调用（modelgw 分级路由 + 预算熔断）。 */\n  private async run(responseId: string): Promise<void> {\n    const record = this.responses().get(responseId)\n    if (!record) return\n    const harness = this.harnesses().get(record.harnessId)\n    const agent = this.ctx.resourceCore.get('agent', record.agentId)\n    if (!agent) {\n      this.finish(record.id, 'failed', { error: t('Agent 资产不存在（可能已被删除）') })\n      return\n    }\n    const model = harness?.model ?? Boolean(input['enabled']) : existing.enabled,\n      createdBy: existing.createdBy,\n    })\n    gate.changeLog(exchange, 'uhp.harness.update', 'uhp_harness', record.id, record.id)\n    return { harness: record }\n  })\n  gate.guarded('DELETE', '/api/uhp/harnesses/:id', 'uhp.admin', (exchange) => {\n    const removed = gateway.removeHarness(exchange.params['id'] ?? '')\n    if (!removed) {\n      exchange.fail(404, 'NOT_FOUND', t('harness 不存在：{id}', { id: exchange.params['id'] ?? '' }))\n      return\n    }\n    gate.changeLog(exchange, 'uhp.harness.delete', 'uhp_harness', exchange.params['id'] ?? '', exchange.params['id'] ?? '')\n    return { deleted: true }\n  })\n  gate.guarded('GET', '/api/uhp/responses', 'uhp.read', (exchange) => {\n    const taskId = exchange.query.get('taskId') ?? ''\n    const agentId = exchange.query.get('agentId') ?? ''\n    const limit = Math.min(Number(exchange.query.get('limit') ?? 50) || 50, 200)\n    const scope = visibleOrgScope(gate.caller(exchange))\n    const scoped = gateway.responses().all().filter((item) => orgVisible(scope, item.agentId))\n    const items = scoped\n      .filter((item) => (taskId ? item.taskId === taskId : true))\n      .filter((item) => (agentId ? item.agentId === agentId : true))\n      .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt))\n      .slice(0, limit)\n    return { total: scoped.length, items: items.map(uhpView) }\n  })\n}\n\n/** 对外视图：Responses 兼容子集字段名（ASCII 协议键，中文释义见协议键对照总表）。 */\nfunction uhpView(record: UhpResponseRecord) {\n  return {\n    id: record.id,\n    status: record.status,\n    model: record.model,\n    harness_id: record.harnessId,\n    output_text: record.outputText,\n    usage: { input_tokens: record.inputTokens, output_tokens: record.outputTokens },\n    session_id: record.sessionId,\n    ...(record.previousResponseId ? { previous_response_id: record.previousResponseId } : {}),\n    ...(record.taskId ? { task_id: record.taskId } : {}),\n    ...(record.error ? { error: record.error } : {}),\n    metadata: JSON.parse(record.metadataJson || '{}') as Record<string, unknown>,\n    created_at: record.createdAt,\n  }\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/plugin-workforce/src/adapters/mcp.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * MCP 资源适配器（§4.2/D.3：数字员工访问业务系统的受控工具出口）。\n *\n * probeGrant：结构化探测 mcpRegistry.authorize(caller, serviceId, toolName)（真实签名）\n * 对 grant 的每个 action 逐一探测——真实生效以网关权限组为准，不做 UI 勾选假设；\n * 权限组引用经 permGroups 结构化探测回填，拿不到则 ref='probe:authorize-only'。\n * invoke：调 mcpRegistry.invoke 走网关原有授权链（两层授权取交集，§9.5），并经第 5 形参\n * workRef 把工作引用（permit/run）透传给网关工作闸门与调用记录（D1 修复：组4 additive\n * 已落地；网关仍不回传调用 ID/usage 事件 ID——gatewayRef 诚实降级记录，不伪造证据）。\n */\nimport { sha256Hex } from '../../../platform-core/src/ids.ts'\nimport { t } from '../../../platform-i18n/src/index.ts'\nimport type {\n  AdapterInvokeInput,\n  AdapterInvokeResult,\n  AdapterProbeResult,\n  ResourceAdapter,\n} from '../contract.ts'\nimport type { IdentityResolution, ResourceGrantSpec } from '../contract.ts'\nimport type { WorkExecutionContext, WorkRefIndex } from '../../../platform-core/src/workforce-port.ts'\n\n/** mcpRegistry 结构化探测面（真实签名见 plugin-mcp/src/index.ts McpService）。 */\ninterface McpRegistryProbe {\n  authorize?: (caller: { type: 'user' | 'agent' | 'app'; id: string; name: string }, serviceId: string, toolName: string) =>\n    { ok: true; readOnly: boolean } | { ok: false; reason: string }\n  invoke?: (caller: { type: 'user' | 'agent' | 'app'; id: string; name: string }, serviceId: string, toolName: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>, workRef?: WorkRefIndex) =>\n    Promise<{ ok: boolean; status: 'ok' | 'error' | 'denied' | 'rate_limited' | 'breaker_open'; latencyMs: number; version: string; result?: unknown; error?: string }>\n  permGroups?: () => { all(): Array<{ id: string; policies: Record<string, unknown>; subjects: Array<{ type: string; id: string }> }> }\n}\n\nexport function createMcpAdapter(ctx: {\n  mcpRegistry?: McpRegistryProbe\n}): ResourceAdapter {\n  const registry = (): McpRegistryProbe => ctx.mcpRegistry ?? {}\n\n  /** 员工机器主体 → 网关 InvokeCaller（绑定 Agent 反查，不接受参数传入身份）。 */\n  const gatewayCaller = (resolution: IdentityResolution): { type: 'agent'; id: string; name: string } => ({\n    type: 'agent',\n    id: resolution.binding.agentId || resolution.employee.primaryAgentId || resolution.employee.id,\n    name: resolution.employee.displayName || resolution.employee.name,\n  })\n\n  return {\n    kind: 'mcp',\n\n    async probeGrant(spec: ResourceGrantSpec, resolution: IdentityResolution): Promise<AdapterProbeResult> {\n      const hub = registry()\n      if (typeof hub.authorize !== 'function') {\n        return { ok: false, message: t('mcpRegistry 未提供 authorize 探测能力，无法核验 MCP 授权') }\n      }\n      const caller = gatewayCaller(resolution)\n      for (const action of spec.actions) {\n        const verdict = hub.authorize(caller, spec.registryId, action)\n        if (!verdict.ok) {\n          return { ok: false, message: t('MCP 授权探针未通过（{handle}）：{reason}', { handle: `${spec.registryId}.${action}`, reason: verdict.reason }) }\n        }\n      }\n      // 权限组证据：结构化探测 permGroups；拿不到则诚实记录 authorize-only\n      try {\n        if (typeof hub.permGroups === 'function') {\n          const agentId = caller.id\n          const groupIds = hub.permGroups().all()\n            .filter((group) => group.policies[spec.registryId]\n              && group.subjects.some((subject) => subject.type === 'agent' && subject.id === agentId))\n            .map((group) => group.id)\n          if (groupIds.length > 0) return { ok: true, ref: `permgroup:${groupIds.join(',')}` }\n        }\n      } catch {\n        // 权限组查询缺席 → 降级记录\n      }\n      return { ok: true, ref: 'probe:authorize-only' }\n    },\n\n    async invoke(input: AdapterInvokeInput): Promise<AdapterInvokeResult> {\n      const hub = registry()\n      if (typeof hub.invoke !== 'function') {\n        return { ok: false, message: t('mcpRegistry 未提供 invoke 能力'), gatewayRef: { outcome: 'denied' } }\n      }\n      const work: WorkExecutionContext = input.work\n      const caller = {\n        type: 'agent' as const,\n        id: work.agentId || work.principalId,\n        name: t('数字员工:{id}', { id: work.employeeId }),\n      }\n      // 工作引用索引（§10.4 / D1 修复）：网关工作闸门按 permitId 核验工作级授权（V28），\n      // 并把 permit/run/employee 关联进网关调用记录与 usage（D11）。仅作索引透传，\n      // 授权事实（permit/租约/清单/参数范围）一律由网关侧服务端回查。stepKey 不在\n      // WorkExecutionContext（账本层唯一约束承载步骤幂等），故不透传。\n      const workRef: WorkRefIndex = {\n        permitId: work.permitId,\n        ...(work.runId ? { runId: work.runId } : {}),\n        ...(work.issueId ? { issueId: work.issueId } : {}),\n        ...(work.traceId ? { traceId: work.traceId } : {}),\n      }\n      const result = await hub.invoke(caller, input.tool.registryId, input.tool.action, input.args, workRef)\n      if (result.ok) {\n        // 网关暂未回传调用 ID/usage 事件 ID（组4 additive 前诚实缺省，不伪造）\n        return {\n          ok: true,\n          value: result.result,\n          gatewayRef: {\n            note: 'mcp 网关暂未回传调用ID',\n            status: result.status,\n            version: result.version,\n            latencyMs: result.latencyMs,\n            workRef: `${work.runId}/${input.invocationId}`,\n            argsHash: sha256Hex(JSON.stringify(input.args)).slice(0, 16),\n          },\n        }\n      }\n      return {\n        ok: false,\n        message: result.error ?? t('MCP 网关拒绝或调用失败'),\n        // denied/breaker_open＝资源级拒绝（停止，不换入口重试）；error＝执行失败\n        gatewayRef: {\n          status: result.status,\n          version: result.version,\n          ...(result.status === 'denied' || result.status === 'breaker_open' ? { outcome: 'denied' } : {}),\n        },\n        ...(result.status === 'rate_limited' ? { rateLimited: true } : {}),\n      }\n    },\n  }\n}\n"
