      "content": "/**\n * 准入与认领服务（实施路径 §6.2/附录 A 决策 3：认领＝幂等确认已分配租约）。\n *\n * claimWork 是 REST /claims 与 exec_claim 兼容包装共用的统一入口：\n * 可信 caller 反查员工 → 任用生效 → 能力清单 → exec-hub 幂等认领（租约权威在\n * exec_run_leases）→ 签发 permit（同 run 幂等，不重复签）。\n * exec-hub 经结构化探测消费（ExecHubWorkIntegration，无反向 import）。\n */\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { Service } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport type {\n  AppointmentRecord,\n  ClaimInput,\n  ClaimOutcome,\n  EmployeeClaimResult,\n  EmployeeLeaseResult,\n  ExecHubWorkIntegration,\n  ManifestRecord,\n  PermitRecord,\n  RunLeaseRecord,\n  WorkforceAdmission,\n  WorkforceCapabilities,\n  WorkforceGrayConfig,\n  WorkforceIdentityResolver,\n  WorkforcePermits,\n  WorkforceStore,\n} from './contract.ts'\nimport { appointmentInEffect } from './domain.ts'\n// WorkforceError 为值导入（领域错误类）：本文件全部拒绝路径（灰度关闭/服务未就绪/任用失效/所有权）共用。\n// 此前遗漏该导入为潜伏缺陷——未触发拒绝路径时不暴露，灰度收口（W7）首次踩中并修复。\nimport { WorkforceError } from './contract.ts'\nimport { t } from '../../platform-i18n/src/index.ts'\nimport type { WorkCallerRef, WorkDenyCode, WorkExecutionContext } from '../../platform-core/src/workforce-port.ts'\n\n/** exec-hub 员工工作集成结构化探针（组3 additive：ctx.execHub.claimForEmployee）。 */\ninterface ExecHubProbe {\n  claimForEmployee?: ExecHubWorkIntegration['claimForEmployee']\n  renewLease?: ExecHubWorkIntegration['renewLease']\n  assertRunOwnership?: ExecHubWorkIntegration['assertRunOwnership']\n  releaseForRun?: ExecHubWorkIntegration['releaseForRun']\n}\n\nfunction probeExecHub(ctx: Context): ExecHubProbe {\n  const hub = (ctx as unknown as { execHub?: ExecHubProbe }).execHub\n  return hub && typeof hub === 'object' ? hub : {}\n}\n\nexport class AdmissionService extends Service implements WorkforceAdmission {\n  static readonly provide = 'workforceAdmission'\n\n  /** 灰度开关（W7 契约 D-② 组织级）：index.ts 装配传入全量 config，缺省 {}＝off 全开（向后兼容）。 */\n  private readonly grayConfig: WorkforceGrayConfig\n\n  constructor(ctx: Context, config: WorkforceGrayConfig = {}) {\n    super(ctx, 'workforceAdmission')\n    this.grayConfig = config\n  }\n\n  // -- 依赖 -------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  private get store(): WorkforceStore {\n    const store = (this.ctx as unknown as { workforceStore?: WorkforceStore }).workforceStore\n    if (!store || typeof store.txn !== 'function') {\n      throw new WorkforceError('WORKFORCE_NOT_READY', t('workforceStore 未就绪（迁移未完成）'), 503)\n    }\n    return store\n  }\n\n  private get identity(): WorkforceIdentityResolver {\n    const resolver = (this.ctx as unknown as { workforceIdentity?: WorkforceIdentityResolver }).workforceIdentity\n    if (!resolver || typeof resolver.resolveByCaller !== 'function') {\n      throw new WorkforceError('WORKFORCE_NOT_READY', t('workforceIdentity 未就绪'), 503)\n    }\n    return resolver\n  }\n\n  private get permits(): WorkforcePermits {\n    const permits = (this.ctx as unknown as { workforcePermits?: WorkforcePermits }).workforcePermits\n    if (!permits || typeof permits.issue !== 'function') {\n      throw new WorkforceError('WORKFORCE_NOT_READY', t('workforcePermits 未就绪'), 503)\n    }\n    return permits\n  }\n\n  private get capabilities(): WorkforceCapabilities {\n    const capabilities = (this.ctx as unknown as { workforceCapabilities?: WorkforceCapabilities }).workforceCapabilities\n    if (!capabilities || typeof capabilities.buildForAppointment !== 'function') {\n      throw new WorkforceError('WORKFORCE_NOT_READY', t('workforceCapabilities 未就绪'), 503)\n    }\n    return capabilities\n  }\n\n  private emit(event: string, payload: unknown): void {\n    try {\n      ;(this.ctx as unknown as { platformBus?: { emit(name: string, payload: unknown): unknown } })\n        .platformBus?.emit(event, payload)\n    } catch {\n      // platformBus 未注入当前 fiber 时跳过\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** 任用失效细分：未生效（准备中/撤销中）与已过期是两种「等待/停止」语义（§13.3）。 */\n  private assertAppointmentEffective(appointment: AppointmentRecord): void {\n    if (appointmentInEffect(appointment)) return\n    const expired = appointment.effectiveUntil !== '' && appointment.effectiveUntil <= new Date().toISOString()\n    throw new WorkforceError(\n      expired ? 'APPOINTMENT_EXPIRED' : 'APPOINTMENT_NOT_EFFECTIVE',\n      expired ? t('任用已过期，请先续任或申请新版本') : t('任用未生效（资源授权准备未完成），不能认领工作'),\n    )\n  }\n\n  // -- 灰度开关（W7 契约 D-②，与 port.authorizeWorkAction 同口径） -----------------------\n\n  /**\n   * 灰度拒绝判定：allowlist 模式且 orgId 不在名单 → true。off 模式（默认）全组织开放，\n   * 等价一期行为。查询面（拉取 work-items、状态查询）不拦——观测面保持开放。\n   */\n  private grayDenied(orgId: string): boolean {\n    return (this.grayConfig.grayMode ?? 'off') === 'allowlist'\n      && !(this.grayConfig.enabledOrgs ?? []).includes(orgId)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 灰度关闭组织的显式拒绝（拒绝语义＝显式拒绝而非静默回落 legacy，V29 同口径：拒绝并可观测）：\n   * emit workforce.gray.denied（surface:'admission'，payload 对齐 port 侧）后抛\n   * WORKFORCE_DISABLED（403）。认领/续租是新工作路径入口，此处收口在确认/延长之前。\n   */\n  private assertGrayOpen(orgId: string, employeeId: string): void {\n    if (!this.grayDenied(orgId)) return\n    try {\n      this.emit('workforce.gray.denied', {\n        orgId,\n        employeeId,\n        surface: 'admission',\n        at: new Date().toISOString(),\n      })\n    } catch {\n      // 通知失败不影响拒绝本身（拒绝先于可观测，fail-closed）\n    }\n    throw new WorkforceError('WORKFORCE_DISABLED', t('数字员工域对组织 {orgId} 处于灰度关闭（仅白名单组织开放）', { orgId }), 403)\n  }\n\n  // -- 认领 -------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  async claimWork(caller: WorkCallerRef, input: ClaimInput): Promise<ClaimOutcome> {\n    // 1. 可信 caller 反查员工（防绕行：与请求是否携带 work 上下文无关，D.5）\n    const resolution = await this.identity.resolveByCaller(caller)\n    if (!resolution) {\n      return { ok: false, code: 'EMPLOYEE_NOT_ACTIVE', message: t('非受管数字员工或绑定缺失') }\n    }\n    // 2. 灰度开关（W7 契约 D-②）：关闭组织在确认前显式拒绝——认领＝幂等确认已分配租约，\n    //    灰度拒绝发生在确认之前（新工作路径入口收口，payload/语义与 port 侧对齐）\n    this.assertGrayOpen(resolution.appointment.orgId, resolution.employee.id)\n    // 3. 任用生效\n    try {\n      this.assertAppointmentEffective(resolution.appointment)\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof WorkforceError) return { ok: false, code: error.code, message: error.message }\n      throw error\n    }\n    // 4. 能力清单（active 复用，否则按生效授权构建——构建含 skill 版本锁定探针，失败即认领失败）\n    let manifest: ManifestRecord\n    try {\n      manifest = this.capabilities.activeForAppointment(resolution.appointment.id)\n        ?? this.capabilities.buildForAppointment(resolution.appointment.id)\n    } catch (error) {\n      return { ok: false, code: 'APPOINTMENT_NOT_EFFECTIVE', message: t('能力清单构建失败：{message}', { message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }) }\n    }\n    // 5. exec-hub 集成（结构化探测；缺席＝工作路径不可用，不静默降级）\n    const hub = probeExecHub(this.ctx)\n    if (typeof hub.claimForEmployee !== 'function') {\n      return { ok: false, code: 'WORKFORCE_NOT_READY', message: t('执行中枢未提供员工工作集成（execHub.claimForEmployee 缺席），工作路径暂不可用') }\n    }\n    const agentKey = input.agentKey?.trim() || resolution.binding.agentId || resolution.employee.primaryAgentId\n    let claim: EmployeeClaimResult\n    try {\n      claim = await hub.claimForEmployee({\n        issueId: input.issueId,\n        employeeId: resolution.employee.id,\n        agentKey,\n        principalId: caller.principalId,\n        ...(input.ttlMs !== undefined ? { ttlMs: input.ttlMs } : {}),\n      })\n    } catch (error) {\n      return { ok: false, code: 'WORKFORCE_NOT_READY', message: t('执行中枢认领异常（fail-closed）：{message}', { message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }) }\n    }\n    if (!claim.ok) {\n      return this.mapClaimFailure(claim)\n    }\n    // 6. permit 幂等：该 run 已有本员工 active 且未过期的 permit → 直接复用，不重复签发\n    const existing = this.store.permits.findWhere({ runId: claim.runId }).find((permit) =>\n      permit.status === 'active'\n      && permit.employeeId === resolution.employee.id\n      && permit.principalId === caller.principalId\n      && (!permit.expiresAt || permit.expiresAt > new Date().toISOString()))\n    if (existing) {\n      return {\n        ok: true,\n        employeeId: resolution.employee.id,\n        agentId: resolution.binding.agentId,\n        issueId: claim.issueId,\n        runId: claim.runId,\n        lease: claim.lease,\n        permit: existing,\n        manifest: this.capabilities.get(existing.manifestId),\n        tools: this.capabilities.toolsFor(existing.manifestId),\n        idempotent: true,\n      }\n    }\n    const permit = this.permits.issue({\n      resolution,\n      issueId: claim.issueId,\n      runId: claim.runId,\n      lease: claim.lease,\n      manifestId: manifest.id,\n      ttlMs: input.ttlMs ?? 0,\n    })\n    this.emit('workforce.claim.succeeded', {\n      employeeId: resolution.employee.id,\n      issueId: claim.issueId,\n      runId: claim.runId,\n      leaseId: claim.lease.id,\n      leaseVersion: claim.lease.leaseVersion,\n      permitId: permit.id,\n      manifestId: manifest.id,\n      idempotent: false,\n    })\n    return {\n      ok: true,\n      employeeId: resolution.employee.id,\n      agentId: resolution.binding.agentId,\n      issueId: claim.issueId,\n      runId: claim.runId,\n      lease: claim.lease,\n      permit,\n      manifest,\n      tools: this.capabilities.toolsFor(manifest.id),\n      idempotent: false,\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** exec-hub 认领失败 → 统一拒绝码映射（错误要能指导「停止/申请/等待/核验/重试」，§13.3）。 */\n  private mapClaimFailure(claim: Extract<EmployeeClaimResult, { ok: false }>): ClaimOutcome {\n    switch (claim.code) {\n      case 'LEASE_HELD_BY_OTHER':\n        return { ok: false, code: 'RUN_NOT_OWNED', message: t('该任务已由其他执行持有（{holder}），停止认领，不要换入口重试', { holder: claim.holder ?? t('未知持有者') }), holder: claim.holder }\n      case 'BUDGET_EXCEEDED':\n        return { ok: false, code: 'BUDGET_EXCEEDED', message: claim.message }\n      case 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED':\n        return { ok: false, code: 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED', message: claim.message }\n      case 'ISSUE_NOT_FOUND':\n      case 'ISSUE_CLOSED':\n        return { ok: false, code: 'RUN_NOT_OWNED', message: t('{message}（该任务当前不可认领，请停止重试）', { message: claim.message }) }\n      case 'ADMISSION_DENIED':\n        return { ok: false, code: 'APPOINTMENT_NOT_EFFECTIVE', message: claim.message }\n      case 'EXEC_HUB_UNAVAILABLE':\n        return { ok: false, code: 'WORKFORCE_NOT_READY', message: claim.message }\n      default:\n        return { ok: false, code: 'POLICY_INTERNAL_ERROR', message: claim.message }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // -- 续租 -------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  async renewWorkLease(caller: WorkCallerRef, permitId: string, ttlMs?: number): Promise<EmployeeLeaseResult> {\n    // D3 修复：verifyPermit 返回 Promise，必须 await 取值——此前 permit.runId 为 undefined，\n    // 续租全路径被 exec-hub「参数不足」守卫拒绝（恒 LEASE_STALE）\n    const permit = await this.verifyPermit(caller, permitId, { requireRun: true })\n    // 灰度收口（W7 契约 D-②，与认领/port 同口径）：关闭组织不得续租延长工作——\n    // orgId 从 permit 绑定的任用回查（不依赖 identity 解析窗口，任用非生效时同样可判）\n    const appointment = this.store.appointments.get(permit.appointmentId)\n    if (appointment) this.assertGrayOpen(appointment.orgId, permit.employeeId)\n    const hub = probeExecHub(this.ctx)\n    if (typeof hub.renewLease !== 'function') {\n      return { ok: false, code: 'EXEC_HUB_UNAVAILABLE', message: t('执行中枢未提供租约续期能力（execHub.renewLease 缺席）') }\n    }\n    return '').trim() || name,\n      orgId,\n      supervisorUserId,\n      status: 'active',\n      primaryAgentId: agentId,\n      createdAt,\n      updatedAt: createdAt,\n    }\n    const binding: BindingRecord = {\n      id: newId('bnd'),\n      employeeId: employee.id,\n      agentId,\n      principalId: String(input.principalId ?? '').trim(),\n      runtime: String(input.runtime ?? '').trim() || 'dsh',\n      capabilityVersion: 1,\n      status: 'active',\n      createdAt,\n      updatedAt: createdAt,\n    }\n\n    // 同事务完成「唯一性域校验 + 员工建档 + 绑定建立」：一对一绑定是冻结决策（附录 A 决策 1）\n    this.store.txn(() => {\n      const conflict = this.store.bindings.findWhere({ agentId, status: 'active' })\n      if (conflict.length > 0) {\n        throw new WorkforceError('PRINCIPAL_BINDING_MISMATCH', t('该技术 Agent 已绑定其他数字员工'))\n      }\n      this.store.employees.insert(employee)\n      this.store.bindings.insert(binding)\n    })\n\n    this.emitEvent('workforce.employee.changed', { employeeId: employee.id, name: employee.name, action: 'created', agentId, orgId })\n    return employee\n  }\n\n  get(id: string): EmployeeRecord {\n    const employee = this.store.employees.get(id)\n    if (!employee) throw new Error(t('数字员工不存在：{id}', { id }))\n    return employee\n  }\n\n  list(filter?: { orgId?: string; status?: EmployeeStatus }): EmployeeRecord[] {\n    let rows = this.store.employees.all()\n    if (filter?.orgId) rows = rows.filter((row) => row.orgId === filter.orgId)\n    if (filter?.status) rows = rows.filter((row) => row.status === filter.status)\n    return rows.sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt < b.createdAt ? -1 : a.createdAt > b.createdAt ? 1 : 0))\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 停职/复岗/离岗：状态机流转 + 联动。\n   * 顺序纪律（fail-closed）：先收扰动面（撤 permit → 释放租约），后落状态——\n   * 撤 permit 失败即中止停职（宁可员工保持在岗，不可留下「停职但 permit 横行」的窗口）；\n   * 释放租约经 exec-hub 结构化探测，缺席/失败记录事件（僵尸锁回收兜底），不中止流程。\n   */\n  setStatus(caller: WorkCallerRef, id: string, status: EmployeeStatus, reason: string): EmployeeRecord {\n    const employee = this.get(id)\n    employeeStatusTransition(employee.status, status) // 非法流转在此抛中文错误\n    const trimmedReason = String(reason ?? '').trim()\n    if ((status === 'suspended' || status === 'offboarded') && trimmedReason === '') {\n      throw new Error(t('停职/离岗必须登记原因（审计与解冻依据）'))\n    }\n    const actionLabel = status === 'suspended' ? t('停职') : status === 'offboarded' ? t('离岗') : t('复岗')\n\n    // 1. 收集该员工当前持有 active permit 的 run（去重），并在撤销前经 activeForRun 复核归属\n    //    （复核必须在撤销 permit 之前完成——撤销后 activeForRun 即为空）\n    const activePermits = this.store.permits.findWhere({ employeeId: id, status: 'active' })\n    const permits = this.permits()\n    const runIds: string[] = []\n    if (status === 'suspended' || status === 'offboarded') {\n      for (const runId of new Set(activePermits.map((permit) => permit.runId).filter((item) => item !== ''))) {\n        const active = permits?.activeForRun(runId)\n        if (permits && (!active || active.employeeId !== id)) continue // activeForRun 复核不过：不释放该 run\n        runIds.push(runId)\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 2. 撤销全部工作授权（工作策略层先失效：新动作立即被拒，V07）\n    if (permits && activePermits.length > 0) {\n      permits.revokeForEmployee(id, t('员工{action}：{reason}', { action: actionLabel, reason: trimmedReason }))\n    }\n\n    // 3. 释放执行租约（exec-hub 集成端口，结构化探测——不产生反向 import）\n    if (status === 'suspended' || status === 'offboarded') {\n      const execHub = this.execHub()\n      const releaseReason = t('员工{action}：{reason}', { action: actionLabel, reason: trimmedReason })\n      for (const runId of runIds) {\n        if (typeof execHub?.releaseForRun !== 'function') {\n          this.emitEvent('workforce.employee.changed', {\n            employeeId: id, action: 'lease_release_skipped', runId, note: '执行中枢租约释放端口未就绪，交由僵尸锁回收兜底',\n          })\n          continue\n        }\n        try {\n          execHub.releaseForRun(runId, releaseReason)\n        } catch (error) {\n          this.emitEvent('workforce.employee.changed', {\n            employeeId: id, action: 'lease_release_failed', runId,\n            note: `租约释放失败（待僵尸锁回收）：${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,\n          })\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 4. 状态机落库（复岗 reactivate 仅 suspended→active，转换表已约束）\n    const updatedAt = nowIso()\n    this.store.txn(() => {\n      this.store.employees.update(id, { status, updatedAt })\n    })\n\n    this.emitEvent('workforce.employee.changed', {\n      employeeId: id, action: 'status', from: employee.status, to: status, reason: trimmedReason,\n      actor: this.actorOf(caller), revokedPermits: activePermits.length, releasedRuns: runIds,\n    })\n    return { ...employee, status, updatedAt }\n  }\n\n  // -- 运行绑定 ------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  bindingsFor(employeeId: string): BindingRecord[] {\n    return this.store.bindings\n      .findWhere({ employeeId })\n      .sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt < b.createdAt ? -1 : a.createdAt > b.createdAt ? 1 : 0))\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 换绑（事务内保证同 Agent 全平台仅一条 active）：\n   * 旧 active 绑定 → inactive；目标 Agent 若被其他员工占用 → 拒绝；\n   * 同 Agent 重复换绑视为幂等更新（回填 principalId/runtime）。\n   * 离岗（终态）员工不允许换绑；停职员工允许（为复岗做准备）。\n   */\n  bindAgent(caller: WorkCallerRef, employeeId: string, agentId: string, principalId?: string, runtime?: string): BindingRecord {\n    const employee = this.get(employeeId)\n    if (employee.status === 'offboarded') throw new Error(t('已离岗员工不接受换绑技术 Agent（如需重新任用请新建数字员工）'))\n    const nextAgentId = String(agentId ?? '').trim()\n    if (nextAgentId === '') throw new Error(t('换绑必须指定目标技术 Agent（agentId）'))\n\n    const createdAt = nowIso()\n    const updated = this.store.txn(() => {\n      const occupied = this.store.bindings.findWhere({ agentId: nextAgentId, status: 'active' })\n      const foreign = occupied.find((binding) => binding.employeeId !== employeeId)\n      if (foreign) throw new WorkforceError('PRINCIPAL_BINDING_MISMATCH', t('该技术 Agent 已绑定其他数字员工'))\n\n      const sameAgent = occupied.find((binding) => binding.employeeId === employeeId)\n      if (sameAgent) {\n        // 幂等：同 Agent 重复换绑，仅回填主体/运行时信息\n        const patch: Partial<BindingRecord> = { updatedAt: createdAt }\n        const trimmedPrincipal = String(principalId ?? '').trim()\n        if (trimmedPrincipal !== '') patch.principalId = trimmedPrincipal\n        const trimmedRuntime = String(runtime ?? '').trim()\n        if (trimmedRuntime !== '') patch.runtime = trimmedRuntime\n        this.store.bindings.update(sameAgent.id, patch)\n        this.store.employees.update(employeeId, { primaryAgentId: nextAgentId, updatedAt: createdAt })\n        return { ...sameAgent, ...patch } as BindingRecord\n      }\n\n      for (const binding of this.store.bindings.findWhere({ employeeId, status: 'active' })) {\n        this.store.bindings.update(binding.id, { status: 'inactive', updatedAt: createdAt })\n      }\n      const created: BindingRecord = {\n        id: newId('bnd'),\n        employeeId,\n        agentId: nextAgentId,\n        principalId: String(principalId ?? '').trim(),\n        runtime: String(runtime ?? '').trim() || 'dsh',\n        capabilityVersion: 1,\n        status: 'active',\n        createdAt,\n        updatedAt: createdAt,\n      }\n      this.store.bindings.insert(created)\n      this.store.employees.update(employeeId, { primaryAgentId: nextAgentId, updatedAt: createdAt })\n      return created\n    })\n\n    this.emitEvent('workforce.employee.changed', {\n      employeeId: employeeId, action: 'rebind', agentId: nextAgentId, previousAgentId: employee.primaryAgentId, actor: this.actorOf(caller),\n    })\n    return updated\n  }\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "packages/plugin-workforce/src/identity-resolver.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * 数字员工身份解析（identity-resolver）—— 可信 caller → 员工/绑定/生效任用。\n *\n * 职责（契约 WorkforceIdentityResolver，蓝本 §5/D.5）：\n *   - 员工机器主体只从 agent 绑定反查：machine 且 refType=agent 且 refId 非空才反查；\n *     human 一律返回 null——员工域没有「人是员工」的通道；\n *   - 受管判定三要素缺一不可：员工在岗（active）＋ 一对一绑定有效 ＋ 存在生效任用\n *     （effective 且在有效期窗口内）；否则返回 null（非受管，旧路径继续原有授权链）；\n *   - 判定只依据已验证 caller 与服务端回查事实：请求参数携带的 employeeId/appointmentId\n *     等身份字段一律不参与判定（防绕行，附录 D.5）。\n *\n * 读路径无写副作用、无事务需求（纯反查），直接走 workforceStore 各表。\n */\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { Service } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport type { ManagedEmployeeRef, WorkCallerRef } from '../../../platform-core/src/workforce-port.ts'\nimport { appointmentInEffect } from './domain.ts'\nimport type { WorkforceIdentityResolver } from './contract.ts'\nimport type { AppointmentRecord, BindingRecord, IdentityResolution, AgentBindingState } from './contract.ts'\nimport type { WorkforceStoreService } from './repositories.ts'\n\nexport class IdentityResolverService extends Service implements WorkforceIdentityResolver {\n  static readonly provide = 'workforceIdentity'\n\n  constructor(ctx: Context) {\n    super(ctx, 'workforceIdentity')\n  }\n\n  // -- 内部取用 -----------------------------------------------------------\n\n  private get store(): WorkforceStoreService {\n    return this.ctx.workforceStore\n  }\n\n  /** 同 Agent 的 active 绑定（一对一纪律兜底：多条时取最早 createdAt 一条，不以最新为准）。 */\n  private activeBindingByAgent(agentId: string): BindingRecord | undefined {\n    return this.store.bindings\n      .findWhere({ agentId, status: 'active' })\n      .sort((a, b) => (a.createdAt < b.createdAt ? -1 : a.createdAt > b.createdAt ? 1 : 0))[0]\n  }\n\n  /** 当前生效任用：status=effective 且在有效期窗口内（appointmentInEffect fail-closed），按 version 降序取最新。 */\n  private latestEffectiveAppointment(employeeId: string): AppointmentRecord | undefined {\n    return this.store.appointments\n      .findWhere({ employeeId })\n      .filter((appt) => appointmentInEffect(appt))\n      .sort((a, b) => b.version - a.version)[0]\n  }\n\n  /** 绑定 → 完整受管身份：员工在岗 + 存在生效任用才返回非 null，否则 null（诚实缺位）。 */\n  private resolutionFor(binding: BindingRecord): IdentityResolution | null {\n    const employee = this.store.employees.get(binding.employeeId)\n    if (!employee || employee.status !== 'active') return null\n    const appointment = this.latestEffectiveAppointment(binding.employeeId)\n    if (!appointment) return null\n    return { employee, binding, appointment }\n  }\n\n  // -- 契约实现 -----------------------------------------------------------\n\n  async resolveByCaller(caller: WorkCallerRef): Promise<IdentityResolution | null> {\n    // human 一律 null：员工域没有「人是员工」的通道（§5，注释即契约语义）\n    if (caller.kind !== 'machine') return null\n    if (caller.refType !== 'agent') return null\n    const refId = typeof caller.refId === 'string' ? caller.refId.trim() : ''\n    if (refId === '') return null\n    const binding = this.activeBindingByAgent(refId)\n    if (!binding) return null\n    return this.resolutionFor(binding)\n  }\n\n  async describeAgent(agentId: string): Promise<ManagedEmployeeRef | null> {\n    const id = String(agentId ?? '').trim()\n    if (id === '') return null\n    const binding = this.activeBindingByAgent(id)\n    if (!binding) return null\n    const resolution = this.resolutionFor(binding)\n    if (!resolution) return null\n    // 受管引用全部来自服务端回查事实（员工/绑定/任用），不回显任何请求自带字段\n    return {\n      employeeId: resolution.employee.id,\n      agentId: binding.agentId,\n      appointmentId: resolution.appointment.id,\n      appointmentVersion: resolution.appointment.version,\n      workOrgId: resolution.appointment.orgId,\n      dataClass: resolution.appointment.dataClass,\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 绑定态三段探测（协作面治理第 2 项，P2-01）：未纳管 / 已纳管但 permit 失效 / permit 生效。\n   * describeAgent 的二分（null 或受管）无法区分前两种——协作面必须区分：\n   * 「从未纳管」按 legacy 放行，「已纳管但离岗/无任用」必须 fail-closed 拒绝。\n   */\n  async inspectAgent(agentId: string): Promise<AgentBindingState> {\n    const id = String(agentId ?? '').trim()\n    if (id === '') return { agentId: id, bound: false, permitEffective: false }\n    const binding = this.activeBindingByAgent(id)\n    if (!binding) return { agentId: id, bound: false, permitEffective: false }\n    const employee = this.store.employees.get(binding.employeeId)\n    if (!employee || employee.status !== 'active') {\n      return {\n        agentId: id, bound: true, permitEffective: false,\n        employeeId: binding.employeeId, bindingId: binding.id, reason: 'EMPLOYEE_NOT_ACTIVE',\n      }\n    }\n    const appointment = this.latestEffectiveAppointment(binding.employeeId)\n    if (!appointment) {\n      return {\n        agentId: id, bound: true, permitEffective: false,\n        employeeId: binding.employeeId, bindingId: binding.id, reason: 'NO_EFFECTIVE_APPOINTMENT',\n      }\n    }\n    return {\n      agentId: id, bound: true, permitEffective: true,\n      employeeId: binding.employeeId, bindingId: binding.id,\n    }\n  }\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "packages/plugin-workforce/src/index.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * plugin-workforce —— 数字员工域装配入口。\n *\n * 职责三分（实施路径 §3.1，不复制三套身份系统）：\n *   - 本插件：员工档案、任用版本、运行绑定、能力清单、permit、受控调用账本、交付验收；\n *   - exec-hub：目标/项目/任务/run 与执行租约（经 ExecHubWorkIntegration 集成端口消费）；\n *   - 各资源网关：实际资源调用与原有授权链（经 adapters 复用，不重写）。\n *\n * 防循环装配（§10.2）：本插件在既有基础服务之后装配；对外的唯一横切面是\n * platform-core 的窄端口（ctx.workforcePolicy，apply 即存在）——本插件 ready 后\n * register() 登记实现；exec-hub 与资源网关仅依赖端口类型，不反向依赖本插件。\n */\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { WorkforceStoreService } from './repositories.ts'\nimport { EmployeeService } from './employee-service.ts'\nimport { AppointmentService } from './appointment-service.ts'\nimport { IdentityResolverService } from './identity-resolver.ts'\nimport { AdmissionService } from './admission-service.ts'\nimport { PermitService } from './permit-service.ts'\nimport { CapabilityManifestService } from './capability-manifest.ts'\nimport { InvocationService } from './invocation-service.ts'\nimport { ArtifactService } from './artifact-service.ts'\nimport { DeliveryService } from './acceptance-service.ts'\nimport { MaintenanceService } from './maintenance-service.ts'\nimport { AdapterRegistryService } from './adapters/index.ts'\nimport { createWorkforcePolicyPort } from './port.ts'\nimport { registerWorkforceTools } from './tools.ts'\nimport { registerWorkforceRoutes } from './routes.ts'\nimport type { WorkforceGrayConfig } from './contract.ts'\n\nexport * from './contract.ts'\n\nexport interface WorkforceConfig extends WorkforceGrayConfig {\n  /** 数据目录（artifact staging 与 SQLite 同底座）；默认 <cwd>/data。 */\n  dataDir?: string\n  /** permit 默认有效期（毫秒），默认 30 分钟。 */\n  permitTtlMs?: number\n  /** 租约默认有效期（毫秒），默认 15 分钟。 */\n  leaseTtlMs?: number\n}\n\nexport const name = 'workforce'\n\n// 提供者均在本插件之前装配（boot-all.ts / cordis.yml 同序）：基础层→网关→agent→exec-hub→workforce\nexport const inject = [\n  'httpServer', 'opsStorage', 'platformBus', 'iam', 'authn', 'audit', 'txnStore', 'usage',\n  'resourceCore', 'agentRegistry', 'mcpRegistry', 'connectorHub', 'modelGateway', 'skillHub', 'nasRegistry',\n  'execHub', 'tools', 'workforcePolicy',\n]\n\nexport async function apply(ctx: Context, config: WorkforceConfig = {}) {\n  // 服务直构（与 plugin-mcp/plugin-connector 同形态）：new Service(ctx) 把 provide 登记进\n  // 本插件自身 fiber——apply 内的端口/工具/路由得以同步读取同插件服务键（ctx.plugin(类) 会\n  // 产生独立子 fiber，同插件键未经 inject 声明不可见，且 await 挂载不保证子 apply 时序）。\n  // 构造序即依赖序：adapters 构造期即读 workforceArtifacts 探测面，故 artifacts 先于 adapters。\n  // 1. 权威存储迁移（幂等建表：WORKFORCE_TABLES）\n  new WorkforceStoreService(ctx, config)\n  // 2. 员工域服务（服务间依赖经 ctx 惰性解析——各服务 getter 在请求期读取，无构造顺序耦合）\n  new EmployeeService(ctx)\n  new AppointmentService(ctx)\n  new IdentityResolverService(ctx)\n  new PermitService(ctx)\n  new CapabilityManifestService(ctx)\n  new ArtifactService(ctx, config)\n  new AdapterRegistryService(ctx)\n  new InvocationService(ctx)\n  new DeliveryService(ctx)\n  // 灰度开关（W7 契约 D-②）：admission 构造接收灰度配置，认领/续租入口按组织拒绝\n  new AdmissionService(ctx, config)\n  // 台账维护（W5 运维面 D-③）：过期 permit 落账 + 终态 run 盘点（封存不删行）；\n  // 构造期起定时巡检（env 可停用），REST /api/workforce/admin/maintenance/run 手动触发\n  new MaintenanceService(ctx)\n  // 3. 登记窄端口实现（platform-core 登记器）：本插件 fiber 已持有全部同插件服务，同步登记\n  //    （灰度配置随端口进入 authorizeWorkAction：关闭组织在工作级授权入口显式拒绝）\n  ctx.workforcePolicy.register(createWorkforcePolicyPort(ctx, config))\n  // 4. 运行时薄工具（workforce_claim/invoke/renew/submit；身份取 exec.principal，禁止 args 传入）\n  registerWorkforceTools(ctx)\n  // 5. REST 工作面（/api/workforce/*，guarded 路由依赖 console 中间件先行）\n  registerWorkforceRoutes(ctx)\n}\n\ndeclare module '@deepseek-ai/cordis' {\n  interface Context {\n    workforceStore: WorkforceStoreService\n    workforceEmployees: EmployeeService\n    workforceAppointments: AppointmentService\n    workforceIdentity: IdentityResolverService\n    workforceAdmission: AdmissionService\n    workforcePermits: PermitService\n    workforceCapabilities: CapabilityManifestService\n    workforceInvocations: InvocationService\n    workforceArtifacts: ArtifactService\n    workforceDelivery: DeliveryService\n    workforceAdapters: AdapterRegistryService\n    workforceMaintenance: MaintenanceService\n  }\n}\n"

      "path": "packages/plugin-workforce/src/invocation-service.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * 受控调用账本服务（实施路径 §9.3/§9.4/§11.5/§11.6 的权威实现）。\n *\n * 调用状态机（§9.3）：reserved → completed / denied / approval_required /\n * rate_limited / failed / outcome_unknown / cancelled。HTTP 状态与领域状态分开保留，\n * 不以 HTTP 200 冒充业务成功。\n *\n * 步骤幂等（§11.5）：runId+stepKey 唯一约束；同步骤同参数已完成→回放原结果；\n * 执行中→返回当前状态；同步骤不同参数→STEP_ARGUMENT_CONFLICT（409）。\n * 网络调用一律在 txnStore 事务外（§9.4）：事务只做短检查/预留/提交。\n * usage 关联（§11.1）：只做 invocation↔usageEvent 映射，不复制消费流水、不双计。\n */\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { Service } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport type {\n  AdapterInvokeResult,\n  AdapterRegistry,\n  InvocationOutcome,\n  InvocationRecord,\n  InvocationRequest,\n  InvocationStatus,\n  ManifestRecord,\n  ManifestToolHandle,\n  PermitRecord,\n  WorkforceIdentityResolver,\n  WorkforceInvocations,\n  WorkforceStore,\n} from './contract.ts'\nimport { WorkforceError, STEP_KEY_PATTERN } from './contract.ts'\nimport { t } from '../../platform-i18n/src/index.ts'\nimport { argsHashOf, validateAgainstSchema } from './domain.ts'\nimport type { WorkCallerRef, WorkDenyCode, WorkExecutionContext } from '../../platform-core/src/workforce-port.ts'\n\n/** 命中即视为「外部写请求已发出但结果不确定」（§11.5-4：先核验，禁止自动重写）。 */\nconst UNCERTAIN_TIMEOUT_PATTERN = /超时|timeout|abort|aborted|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT/i\n\nexport class InvocationService extends Service implements WorkforceInvocations {\n  static readonly provide = 'workforceInvocations'\n\n  constructor(ctx: Context) {\n    super(ctx, 'workforceInvocations')\n  }\n\n  // -- 依赖 -------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  private get store(): WorkforceStore {\n    const store = (this.ctx as unknown as { workforceStore?: WorkforceStore []).includes(field)) {\n      if (typeof value === 'string') return value\n      return JSON.stringify(value ?? null)\n    }\n    return (value === undefined ? null : value) as SqlValue\n  }\n\n  private encodeRow(record: Record<string, unknown>): Row {\n    const row: Row = {}\n    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(record)) row[key] = this.encodeField(key, value)\n    return row\n  }\n\n  /** 读出解码：jsonFields 反序列化；坏 JSON 按原始文本保留（诚实呈现，不静默修复）。 */\n  private decodeRow(row: Row): T {\n    const jsonFields = this.spec.jsonFields ?? }\n\n  findWhere(where: Record<string, SqlValue>): T[] {\n    const encoded: Row = {}\n    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(where)) encoded[key] = this.encodeField(key, value)\n    return this.svc.all<Row>(this.spec.name, encoded).map((row) => this.decodeRow(row))\n  }\n\n  update(id: string, patch: Partial<T>): void {\n    const encoded = this.encodeRow(patch as Record<string, Math.min(Math.floor(raw), 500) : 50\n  }\n\n  gate.guarded('POST', '/api/workforce/admin/employees/status-batch', 'workforce.admin', async (exchange) => {\n    const svc = services(ctx)\n    const body = readBody(exchange)\n    const rawIds = Array.isArray(body['employeeIds']) ? body['employeeIds'].map((item) => String(item).trim()) : []\n    const employeeIds = [...new Set(rawIds.filter((item) => item !== ''))]\n    if (employeeIds.length === 0) throw new WorkforceError('ARGUMENT_SCOPE_DENIED', t('employeeIds 必须为非空员工 ID 数组'))\n    if (employeeIds.length > 200) throw new WorkforceError('ARGUMENT_SCOPE_DENIED', t('employeeIds 单批上限 200（逐员工撤权联动，防止超长批次）'))\n    const status = String(body['status'] ?? '')\n    if (status !== 'suspended' && status !== 'active') {\n      throw new WorkforceError('ARGUMENT_SCOPE_DENIED', t('批量状态只允许 suspended（停职）/ active（复岗）：{status}', { status: status || t('（空）') }))\n    }\n    const reason = String(body['reason'] ?? '').trim()\n    if (reason === '') throw new WorkforceError('ARGUMENT_SCOPE_DENIED', t('批量停职/复岗必须登记 reason（审计与解冻依据）'))\n    const caller = callerRefOf(gate, exchange)\n    const now = new Date().toISOString()\n    const results: Array<{ employeeId: string; ok: boolean; error?: string; revokedPermits?: number; releasedRuns?: string[] }> = []\n    // 逐员工独立事务（不整批回滚）：setStatus 内部「撤 permit→释放租约→状态落库」是单员工\n    // 完整 fail-closed 闭环（employee-service.ts 一字不改）；部分失败如实呈现在 results，\n    // 响应即实体现实况，运维按条补办。\n    for (const employeeId of employeeIds) {\n      const beforeActive = svc.store.permits.findWhere({ employeeId, status: 'active' })\n      try {\n        await svc.employees.setStatus(caller, employeeId, status, reason)\n        const afterStatus = new Map(svc.store.permits.findWhere({ employeeId }).map((permit) => [permit.id, permit.status]))\n        // releasedRuns：停职时取「撤前 active permit 的 run，且撤后该 run 已无有效 permit」；\n        // 复岗不释放租约（恒空）。租约权威在 exec-hub（终态封存），此处为台账可观测投影。\n        const releasedRuns = status === 'suspended'\n          ? [...new Set(beforeActive.map((permit) => permit.runId).filter((runId) => runId !== ''))]\n              .filter((runId) => !svc.store.permits.findWhere({ runId })\n                .some((permit) => permit.status === 'active' && (!permit.expiresAt || permit.expiresAt > now)))\n          : []\n        results.push({\n          employeeId,\n          ok: true,\n          revokedPermits: beforeActive.filter((permit) => afterStatus.get(permit.id) !== 'active').length,\n          releasedRuns,\n        })\n      } catch (error) {\n        results.push({ employeeId, ok: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) })\n      }\n    }\n    const succeeded = results.filter((item) => item.ok).length\n    const failed = results.length - succeeded\n    gate.changeLog(exchange, 'workforce.employee.status-batch', 'employee', employeeIds.slice(0, 5).join(','),\n      '', `批量${status === 'suspended' ? '停职' : '复岗'}：${reason}；ids=${employeeIds.join(',')}；succeeded=${succeeded} failed=${failed}`)\n    return { results, succeeded, failed }\n  })\n\n  gate.guarded('GET', '/api/workforce/admin/employees/:id/audit', 'workforce.admin', (exchange) => {\n    const svc = services(ctx)\n    const employeeId = exchange.params['id'] ?? ''\n    const employee = svc.store.employees.get(employeeId)\n    if (!employee) throw new Error(t('数字员工不存在：{id}', { id: employeeId }))\n    // 跨组织穿透说明：本端点由 workforce.admin 把守，直接读 store 表按 employeeId/appointmentId\n    // 串链（不走 assertReadable 的 org 隔离）——admin 运维面审计报表，权限点即边界。\n    const limit = readLimit(exchange.query)\n    const now = new Date().toISOString()\n    const bindings = svc.store.bindings.findWhere({ employeeId })\n    const appointments = svc.store.appointments.findWhere({ employeeId })\n      .sort((a, b) => a.version - b.version)\n      .map((appointment) => ({\n        ...appointment,\n        grants: svc.store.grants.findWhere({ appointmentId: appointment.id }),\n        manifest: svc.store.manifests.findWhere({ appointmentId: appointment.id })\n          .sort((a, b) => b.version - a.version)[0] ?? null,\n      }))\n    const permits = svc.store.permits.findWhere({ employeeId })\n    const allInvocations = svc.store.invocations.findWhere({ employeeId })\n      .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt))\n    const deliverables = svc.store.deliverables.findWhere({ employeeId })\n    return {\n      employee,\n      bindings,\n      appointments,\n      permits,\n      invocations: allInvocations.slice(0, limit),\n      deliverables,\n      summary: {\n        // 有效=active 且未过 expiresAt；过期按 expiresAt<=now 事实计算（库里可能还没有\n        // expired 落账行——落账收敛见 MaintenanceService.run）\n        permitActive: permits.filter((permit) => permit.status === 'active' && (!permit.expiresAt || permit.expiresAt > now)).length,\n        permitExpired: permits.filter((permit) => permit.expiresAt !== '' && permit.expiresAt <= now).length,\n        invocationCount: allInvocations.length,\n        invocationDenied: allInvocations.filter((item) => item.status === 'denied').length,\n        deliverableAccepted: deliverables.filter((item) => item.status === 'accepted').length,\n        deliverableRejected: deliverables.filter((item) => item.status === 'rejected').length,\n      },\n    }\n  })\n\n  gate.guarded('GET', '/api/workforce/admin/invocations', 'workforce.admin', (exchange) => {\n    const svc = services(ctx)\n    // 跨组织调用账本穿透查询（admin 运维面，权限点即边界；工作面 GET /invocations 只按 runId\n    // 且过归属校验——本端点是运维对账口，createdAt 倒序）\n    const query = exchange.query\n    const employeeId = query.get('employeeId') ?? ''\n    const runId = query.get('runId') ?? ''\n    const status = query.get('status') ?? ''\n    let rows = svc.store.invocations.all()\n    if (employeeId) rows = rows.filter((row) => row.employeeId === employeeId)\n    if (runId) rows = rows.filter((row) => row.runId === runId)\n    if (status) rows = rows.filter((row) => row.status === status)\n    return rows.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt)).slice(0, readLimit(query))\n  })\n\n  gate.guarded('POST', '/api/workforce/admin/maintenance/run', 'workforce.admin', (exchange) => {\n    // 定时器跑 + admin 手动跑同一函数（POST /api/exec/tick、POST /api/usage/retention/purge 同款先例）\n    const maintenance = (ctx as unknown as { workforceMaintenance?: { run(): MaintenanceRunResult } }).workforceMaintenance\n    if (!maintenance || typeof maintenance.run !== 'function') {\n      throw new WorkforceError('WORKFORCE_NOT_READY', t('台账维护服务未就绪'), 503)\n    }\n    const result = maintenance.run()\n    gate.changeLog(exchange, 'workforce.maintenance.run', 'maintenance', 'workforce-ledger', '台账巡检', JSON.stringify(result))\n    return result\n  })\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * 运行时薄工具（workforce_claim / workforce_invoke / workforce_renew / workforce_submit）。\n *\n * 纪律（§10.3/D02）：身份一律取 exec.principal（入口从令牌解析后注入），禁止从 args\n * 读取身份；principal 缺失 fail-closed 返回中文错误。工具只是业务服务的薄封装，\n * REST / MCP / 宿主三端转同一服务，不复制实现（§13.1）。\n */\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport { defineTool } from '../../platform-core/src/tools-lite.ts'\nimport type { WorkCallerRef } from '../../platform-core/src/workforce-port.ts'\nimport type { ToolPrincipal, ToolRunContext } from '../../platform-core/src/tools-lite.ts'\nimport { WorkforceError } from './contract.ts'\nimport { t } from '../../platform-i18n/src/index.ts'\nimport type {\n  ClaimOutcome,\n  InvocationOutcome,\n} from './contract.ts'\n\n/** exec.principal → 可信 caller（缺 refType/refId 时照实缺省——组1 resolver 只认 refType='agent'）。 */\nfunction callerRefOf(principal: ToolPrincipal | undefined): WorkCallerRef {\n  if (!principal || !principal.principalId) {\n    throw new WorkforceError('PRINCIPAL_BINDING_MISMATCH', t('缺少调用主体身份（fail-closed）：工具不允许从参数读取身份'))\n  }\n  return {\n    kind: principal.kind,\n    principalId: principal.principalId,\n    ...(principal.userId ? { userId: principal.userId } : {}),\n    ...(principal.refType !== undefined ? { refType: principal.refType } : {}),\n    ...(principal.refId !== undefined ? { refId: principal.refId } : {}),\n    ...(principal.name ? { name: principal.name } : {}),\n  }\n}\n\n/** 服务拒绝 → 结构化失败负载（code 英文枚举 + message 中文，§13.3）。 */\nfunction failureOf(error: unknown): { ok: false; code: string; message: string } {\n  if (error instanceof WorkforceError) {\n    return { ok: false, code: error.code, message: error.message }\n  }\n  return { ok: false, code: 'POLICY_INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }\n}\n\nfunction structuredServices(ctx: Context): {\n  admission: { claimWork: import('./contract.ts').WorkforceAdmission['claimWork']; renewWorkLease: import('./contract.ts').WorkforceAdmission['renewWorkLease'] }\n  invocations: { invoke: import('./contract.ts').WorkforceInvocations['invoke'] }\n  delivery: { submit: import('./contract.ts').WorkforceDelivery['submit'] }\n} {\n  const source = ctx as unknown as {\n    workforceAdmission?: import('./contract.ts').WorkforceAdmission\n    workforceInvocations?: import('./contract.ts').WorkforceInvocations\n    workforceDelivery?: import('./contract.ts').WorkforceDelivery\n  }\n  if (!source.workforceAdmission || !source.workforceInvocations || !source.workforceDelivery) {\n    throw new WorkforceError('WORKFORCE_NOT_READY', t('数字员工服务未就绪'), 503)\n  }\n  return {\n    admission: source.workforceAdmission,\n    invocations: source.workforceInvocations,\n    delivery: source.workforceDelivery,\n  }\n}\n\nexport function registerWorkforceTools(ctx: Context): void {\n  const tools = (ctx as unknown as {\n    tools?: { register(definition: ReturnType<typeof defineTool>): unknown }\n  }).tools\n  if (!tools || typeof tools.register !== 'function') {\n    throw new Error(t('tools 运行时未就绪，workforce 工具无法注册'))\n  }\n\n  tools.register(defineTool({\n    name: 'workforce_claim',\n    plugin: 'workforce',\n    permission: 'workforce.invoke',\n    description: '数字员工认领任务：幂等确认已分配租约并取得工作授权（permit）与能力清单。返回 runId/permitId/可用工具句柄；重复认领同任务返回既有授权（idempotent）。',\n    parameters: {\n      issueId: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '任务 ID（执行中枢 issue）' },\n      agentKey: { type: 'string', description: '运行时别名（可选，兼容 exec_claim；主体归属仍以令牌反查为准）' },\n      ttlMinutes: { type: 'number', description: 'permit/租约有效期（分钟，可选）' },\n    },\n    output: {\n      type: 'object',\n      properties: {\n        ok: { type: 'boolean' },\n        runId: { type: 'string' },\n        permitId: { type: 'string' },\n        leaseVersion: { type: 'number' },\n        tools: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },\n        idempotent: { type: 'boolean' },\n        code: { type: 'string' },\n        message: { type: 'string' },\n      },\n      required: ['ok'],\n    },\n    async execute(args, exec: ToolRunContext) {\n      let caller: WorkCallerRef\n      try {\n        caller = callerRefOf(exec.principal)\n      } catch (error) {\n        return failureOf(error)\n      }\n      try {\n        const outcome: ClaimOutcome = await structuredServices(ctx).admission.claimWork(caller, {\n          issueId: String(args.issueId ?? ''),\n          ...(typeof args.agentKey === 'string' && args.agentKey ? { agentKey: args.agentKey } : {}),\n          ...(typeof args.ttlMinutes === 'number' && args.ttlMinutes > 0 ? { ttlMs: Math.round(args.ttlMinutes * 60_000) } : {}),\n        })\n        if (!outcome.ok) {\n          return { ok: false, code: outcome.code, message: outcome.message, ...(outcome.holder ? { holder: outcome.holder } : {}) }\n        }\n        return {\n          ok: true,\n          runId: outcome.runId,\n          permitId: outcome.permit.id,\n          leaseVersion: outcome.lease.leaseVersion,\n          tools: outcome.tools.map((tool) => tool.handle),\n          idempotent: outcome.idempotent,\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        return failureOf(error)\n      }\n    },\n  }))\n\n  tools.register(defineTool({\n    name: 'workforce_invoke',\n    plugin: 'workforce',\n    permission: 'workforce.invoke',\n    description: '数字员工受控资源调用：permit + 工具句柄 + 业务步骤键（stepKey）+ 参数。返回领域状态（completed/denied/approval_required/rate_limited/failed/outcome_unknown）——denied 停止该动作不换入口重试；outcome_unknown 先核验禁止自动重写。',\n    parameters: {\n      permitId: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '工作授权 permit（workforce_claim 返回）' },\n      toolHandle: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '工具句柄（能力清单下发，形如 registry.action）' },\n      stepKey: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '业务步骤键（同步骤同参数幂等；不同参数冲突拒绝）' },\n      arguments: { type: 'object', description: '调用参数（须在句柄参数 schema 与业务范围约束内）' },\n      traceId: { type: 'string', description: '工作 trace 引用（可选索引）' },\n    },\n    output: {\n      type: 'object',\n      properties: {\n        status: { type: 'string', enum: ['completed', 'denied', 'approval_required', 'rate_limited', 'failed', 'outcome_unknown', 'cancelled'] },\n        invocationId: { type: 'string' },\n        value: {},\n        content: { type: 'string' },\n        gatewayRef: { type: 'object' },\n        code: { type: 'string' },\n        message: { type: 'string' },\n        approvalRef: { type: 'string' },\n      },\n      required: ['status', 'invocationId'],\n    },\n    async execute(args, exec: ToolRunContext) {\n      let caller: WorkCallerRef\n      try {\n        caller = callerRefOf(exec.principal)\n      } catch (error) {\n        return failureOf(error)\n      }\n      try {\n        const outcome: InvocationOutcome = await structuredServices(ctx).invocations.invoke(caller, {\n          permitId: String(args.permitId ?? ''),\n          toolHandle: String(args.toolHandle ?? ''),\n          stepKey: String(args.stepKey ?? ''),\n          arguments: args.arguments,\n          ...(typeof args.traceId === 'string' && args.traceId ? { traceId: args.traceId } : {}),\n        })\n        // 按领域状态透传（中文 message），不以 HTTP/工具成功冒充业务成功\n        return outcome\n      } catch (error) {\n        return failureOf(error)\n      }\n    },\n  }))\n\n  tools.register(defineTool({\n    name: 'workforce_renew',\n    plugin: 'workforce',\n    permission: 'workforce.invoke',\n    description: '数字员工续租/进度心跳：同主体、同 run、未撤销且未过期才能续。长时间执行请在租约到期前调用。',\n    parameters: {\n      permitId: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '工作授权 permit' },\n      ttlMinutes: { type: 'number', description: '续租时长（分钟，可选）' },\n    },\n    output: {\n      type: 'object',\n      properties: {\n        ok: { type: 'boolean' },\n        lease: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: true },\n        code: { type: 'string' },\n        message: { type: 'string' },\n      },\n      required: ['ok'],\n    },\n    async execute(args, exec: ToolRunContext) {\n      let caller: WorkCallerRef\n      try {\n        caller = callerRefOf(exec.principal)\n      } catch (error) {\n        return failureOf(error)\n      }\n      try {\n        const result = await structuredServices(ctx).admission.renewWorkLease(\n          caller,\n          String(args.permitId ?? ''),\n          typeof args.ttlMinutes === 'number' && args.ttlMinutes > 0 ? Math.round(args.ttlMinutes * 60_000) : undefined,\n        )\n        if (!result.ok) return { ok: false, code: result.code, message: result.message }\n        return { ok: true, lease: result.lease }\n      } catch (error) {\n        return failureOf(error)\n      }\n    },\n  }))\n\n  tools.register(defineTool({\n    name: 'workforce_submit',\n    plugin: 'workforce',\n    permission: 'workforce.invoke',\n    description: '数字员工提交结构化交付：校验 run 归属与 artifact 证据归属，任务转待审 review，等待真人验收（模型输出「成功」不等于业务验收通过）。',\n    parameters: {\n      permitId: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '工作授权 permit' },\n      summary: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '交付摘要' },\n      artifactIds: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, required: true, description: '交付证据 artifact ID 列表（须属本 run）' },\n    },\n    output: {\n      type: 'object',\n      properties: {\n        ok: { type: 'boolean' },\n        deliverableId: { type: 'string' },\n        version: { type: 'number' },\n        status: { type: 'string' },\n        code: { type: 'string' },\n        message: { type: 'string' },\n      },\n      required: ['ok'],\n    },\n    async execute(args, exec: ToolRunContext) {\n      let caller: WorkCallerRef\n      try {\n        caller = callerRefOf(exec.principal)\n      } catch (error) {\n        return failureOf(error)\n      }\n      try {\n        const record = await structuredServices(ctx).delivery.submit(caller, {\n          permitId: String(args.permitId ?? ''),\n          summary: String(args.summary ?? ''),\n          artifactIds: Array.isArray(args.artifactIds) ? args.artifactIds.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string') : [],\n        })\n        return { ok: true, deliverableId: record.id, version: record.version, status: record.status }\n      } catch (error) {\n        return failureOf(error)\n      }\n    },\n  }))\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * 插件树组装：按依赖顺序挂载全部平台插件。\n * 这棵树等价于 cordis.yml 在完整 dsh 中加载的内容——一份插件代码，两种宿主。\n */\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport * as platformCore from '@dsh-ops/platform-core'\nimport * as resourceCore from '@dsh-ops/plugin-resource-core'\nimport * as iam from '@dsh-ops/plugin-iam'\nimport * as authn from '@dsh-ops/plugin-authn'\nimport * as usage from '@dsh-ops/plugin-usage'\n// plugin-billing 已下线封存（M0-2，2026-09-09）：钱包/复式分账功能面退出运行时，\n// 存量流水经 scripts/billing-archive-export.mjs 导出 CSV 只读封存 90 天（见 docs/billing-archive-register.md）。\nimport * as audit from '@dsh-ops/plugin-audit'\nimport * as market from '@dsh-ops/plugin-market'\nimport * as connector from '@dsh-ops/plugin-connector'\nimport * as modelgw from '@dsh-ops/plugin-modelgw'\nimport * as mcp from '@dsh-ops/plugin-mcp'\nimport * as nas from '@dsh-ops/plugin-nas'\nimport * as skillhub from '@dsh-ops/plugin-skillhub'\nimport * as agent from '@dsh-ops/plugin-agent'\nimport * as app from '@dsh-ops/plugin-app'\nimport * as connect from '@dsh-ops/plugin-connect'\nimport * as update from '@dsh-ops/plugin-update'\nimport * as portal from '@dsh-ops/plugin-portal'\nimport * as consolePlugin from '@dsh-ops/plugin-console'\nimport * as panelCore from '@dsh-ops/plugin-panel-core'\nimport * as flowCore from '@dsh-ops/plugin-flow-core'\nimport * as execHub from '@dsh-ops/plugin-exec-hub'\nimport * as workforce from '@dsh-ops/plugin-workforce'\nimport * as dingtalkBridge from '@dsh-ops/plugin-dingtalk-bridge'\n// 企业数字员工内网协作（A2A/UHP，协作方案 §4/§11）：UHP 执行驱动层（Server 协议面 + configured\n// harness 注册表）先于 A2A 协作平面装配；两者间联动只走 ctx.platformBus（a2a.task.* 事件族）\nimport * as uhp from '@dsh-ops/plugin-uhp'\nimport * as a2a from '@dsh-ops/plugin-a2a'\n// W2 启动健壮性：双实例断言 + 装配后插件树体检\nimport { assertSingleRoot, formatTreeHealth, probeTree } from '@dsh-ops/platform-core'\n\nexport interface BootOptions {\n  dataDir: string\n  port: number\n}\n\nexport async function bootAll(ctx: Context, options: BootOptions): Promise<void> {\n  // 装配前断言进程内只有一个 root（双实例会让 fiber 静默 PENDING，必须 fail-fast）\n  assertSingleRoot(ctx)\n  await ctx.plugin(platformCore, { dataDir: options.dataDir, http: { port: options.port } })\n  const restored = await ctx.opsStorage.restoreAll()\n  if (restored.length > 0) {\n    ctx.logger('boot').info(`已从磁盘恢复 ${restored.length} 个数据集合`)\n  }\n  await ctx.plugin(resourceCore)\n  await ctx.plugin(iam)\n  await ctx.plugin(authn)\n  await ctx.plugin(usage)\n  await ctx.plugin(audit)\n  await ctx.plugin(market)\n  // 连接器纳管（open-connector
